s.t:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Stripe is building the economic engine for AI – and it’s working. Today, 88% of the Forbes AI 50 are building on Stripe (and most of the remaining 12% are pre-monetization).
The AI GTM team is focused on helping AI-native businesses monetize and scale. We're in a unique position—partnering with the world's most ambitious AI companies (like OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, and NVIDIA) to help them grow. This is one of the fastest growing parts of the business, and we need more great people to help us continue to accelerate.

As a Sales Manager on the AI GTM team at Stripe, you will leverage your sales leadership and product expertise to drive growth through new and existing strategic AI customers. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer of AI, you will lead a team of Account Executives responsible for expanding Stripe's relationship with some of the most important AI companies in the world—across payments, billing, and beyond.
You will be instrumental in leading in-depth product discussions with customers, developing consultative and solution-based sales strategies, and building deep knowledge of the AI industry and its unique monetization challenges. You will collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Product Marketing, and User Operations teams to develop and execute against our go-to-market strategy.

Develop the long-term vision for a growing AI GTM team and scale day-to-day operations.
Lead and manage a team of Account Executives managing existing AI accounts (driving revenue expansion, product attach, and retention) and looking for new business opportunities. Establish strategic plans and objectives to drive growth across the AI GTM business line, guiding execution to KPIs.
Build and develop a high-performing team, fostering a strong culture of energized and engaged Stripes while investing in the growth and development of your team. Coach and guide the team in developing consultative and solution-based sales skills throughout the sales cycle.
Be accountable for driving revenue, increasing product attach rates, and growing existing clients at high rates.
Engage with Product, Marketing, and User Operations teams to influence our product roadmap (you are on the frontier!) and accelerate our growth trajectory for our AI industry users.
Serve as both an internal and customer-facing expert on Stripe's products, particularly as they apply to AI-native business models (usage-based billing, marketplace payments, embedded finance, agentic commerce).
Build strong relationships with customer executives (CEO, CFO, CTO) and serve as a trusted advisor on how Stripe can support their growth.
Create best practices and improve the business and customer engagement model.

Sales leader. You are an adept sales leader, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization. You see value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require both deep product understanding and technical knowledge, especially for AI industry users.
People developer. You are a strong people leader who builds high-performing teams through coaching, accountability, and culture. You're as comfortable working with clients as with internal stakeholders (including executives) and are excited to become an expert and share your knowledge. You possess an organized, self-starter mindset and excellent communication skills, with a track record for improving the processes and organizations around you.
AI enthusiast. You have deep context in the AI industry and are energized by keeping up with new developments in the space. You bring a user-first mindset— you approach every customer interaction as a consultative partner rather than a transactional seller.
Technically curious. You understand APIs, webhooks, and modern developer tools—and you can hold credible conversations with engineering leaders about how Stripe's infrastructure fits into their stack.

8+ years of sales leadership experience, launching and growing high-functioning sales teams/products.
10+ years of experience in hyper-growth SaaS or technology environments across the AMER region.
Demonstrated success managing existing/growth customer portfolios and driving revenue expansion.
Proven ability to be a self-starter, capable of driving business results without significant supervision.
Ability to understand complex technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple stakeholders.
Deep understanding of AI industry dynamics, business models, and monetization strategies (usage-based pricing, API-first distribution, agentic commerce).
Strong product acumen—ability to learn and articulate complex product capabilities, understand how they work technically, and connect them to user needs.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong presentation skills for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders.
An enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality.
Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke agreements with commercial and enterprise businesses.

Industry experience in payments, financial infrastructure, developer tools, or AI/ML platforms.
Existing relationships within the AI ecosystem (AI labs, AI-native SaaS companies, developer platforms).
Experience selling complex platform solutions involving multiple products.
Prior experience at a growth-stage software company or a leading payments/fintech company.
Familiarity with Stripe's product suite and how AI companies leverage financial infrastructure to scale.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
We're looking for a Client Account Manager to join the Media & Entertainment vertical of our Global Strategic Accounts team. This team is a specialized group within Global Large Customer Sales that oversees Reddit’s most significant global advertising partners end-to end — leading joint business planning, global strategy, and cross-regional execution.
This person will closely collaborate with their Client Partner on campaign execution and optimizations to help agencies and advertisers achieve their marketing objectives on the fast-growing Reddit platform.
Please note that this role is required to be based out of New York City or Los Angeles.

Collaborate closely with Client Partners to meet and exceed your clients’ marketing goals
Proactively manage and deepen relationships with existing advertising partners, both with agencies and directly with Global clients, to drive year-on-year Reddit revenue growth
Lead and execute campaign launches from start to finish, delivering insightful optimization recommendations to agency and client partners
​​Run end-to-end global account operations: revenue delivery, complex media strategy, multi-market optimizations, troubleshooting, and structured upsell on a global book
Act as the primary point of contact for internal account operations, including managing revenue delivery, troubleshooting issues, and escalating when necessary
Educate brands and media agencies, effectively communicating Reddit’s value proposition and best practices for advertising on the platform
Consult clients on their awareness and direct response objectives, partnering closely with Client Partners to craft thoughtful and creative media plans
Collaborate with Ad Ops to ensure effective campaign delivery and resolve any technical hurdles
Dive deep into campaign performance data, audience and competitor insights, seasonality, and market and performance trends to develop KPI-driven campaign recommendations
Proactively seek and represent client needs and asks to cross-functional stakeholders

Collaborate closely with Client Partners to meet and exceed clients’ marketing goals.
Proactively manage and deepen relationships with existing advertising partners, both with agencies and directly with Fortune 500 clients to drive year-on-year Reddit revenue growth.
Lead and execute campaign launches from start to finish and deliver insightful optimizations to agency and client partners
Ongoing management of internal account operations (revenue delivery and troubleshooting issues)
Educate brands and media agencies, effectively communicate value proposition and best practices
Consult clients on their awareness and direct response objectives, and partner closely with Client Partners to craft thoughtful and creative media plans
Collaborate with Ad Ops to ensure effective campaign delivery and resolve any technical hurdles
Proactively seek and represent client needs and asks to cross-functional stakeholders
Shape Reddit’s native ads product roadmap, for mobile and in general, by aggregating and sharing client feedback and campaign metrics with cross-functional stakeholders
Proactively and continually identify areas of improvement
Mentor and train other team members.

8+ years of experience in advertising sales and account management, Media & Entertainment client experience preferred
Strong understanding of customer marketing funnel and traditional marketing ecosystem
Comfortable with problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors.
Understanding of Digital measurement, tracking fundamentals and mobile measurement partners
Tenacious and entrepreneurial approach to working through product, process, and client challenges
Experience cultivating strong relationships with external partners
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills

The Sr CRM Account Executive - Manufacturing will oversee market success of ServiceNow's CRM products. These products are built on our market leading Service Management platform and create a single source of truth that allows enterprise processes to execute with uniform information.

s.h: What you get to do in this role
s.t:
The Sr CRM Account Executive - Manufacturing supports the strategy and solution win for specialty solution areas depending on engagement model. Responsibilities/ activities can vary by solution area given coverage capacity.
Support territory strategy and planning to improve vertical agreement, account use case targeting and execution
Provide input to AE during the account planning process based on territory strategy and recommendation
Ensure recommendation to territory strategy and account planning is aligned with Now Value principles
Support customers to envision the value of a digital transformation and support development of strategy by partnering with rest of account team, customer and partners.
Interlock with SC & Specialist SC on Capability Roadmap for feedback and agreement and team based on engagement model
Coach AEs, ADRs, ACE with foundational specialty solution area knowledge to identify specialty solution opportunities and help manage the sales cycle
Customize the time allocation of responsibilities to the needs of the territory and account team and celebrate successes

s.t:
Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.
We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.
Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

We are hiring a Client Success Account Manager to our Client Success team in Paraná.
This role is to join the B2B team and will be responsible for managing a key portfolio of our clients. As a Client Success Manager, you will be expected to bring significant business results to Wellhub through upselling, cross selling and renegotiation within existing accounts. This person will also work in collaboration with different areas of Wellhub to improve and evolve the client's experience.
This is a great opportunity to join a growing team in a market that is really gaining momentum on B2B business and we are excited to have a game-changer candidate to take us to the next level.

Develop a sales plan for each named client — identifying products, expansion opportunities, and the strategic rationale ("why Wellhub") — leading the client relationship for a portfolio of large and complex Enterprise accounts throughout the client lifecycle.
Ensure contract renewals, expansions, and lead annual contract renegotiations.
Partner with client's HR and decision makers, building an approach to connect their C-level to Wellhub executives (and/or executives at other clients) to broaden and deepen engagement with Wellhub.
Use data and market analysis to identify risks, opportunities, and build data-backed narratives to support negotiations and retention strategies.
Provide product feedback (client requirements, product shortcomings, enhancements, etc.) to product management.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

Based in Paraná — hybrid model, with in-person client visits.
Previous experience in a client-facing role, leading large and complex Enterprise client relationships, with proven cross-selling and upselling results in an existing portfolio.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data to support decision-making, negotiations, and client strategy.
Strong communication skills to engage with senior stakeholders, including Director and C-level audiences.
Ability to identify root causes and solve problems creatively and efficiently.
Ability to operate independently and manage multiple clients/projects concurrently with strong attention to detail.
Able to analyze and improve current processes/protocols and anticipate/manage change in a fast-moving global business environment.
Highly proficient in English.
We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience managing large and complex Enterprise client portfolios and advanced proficiency in English, are mandatory requirements.

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.
Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.
WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.
HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.
FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.
FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.
PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!
PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.
CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.
CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.
Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube !

Klaviyo’s Partnerships team drives durable growth through an ecosystem of agencies, systems integrators, consultants, MSPs, OSPs, and other strategic services partners. We work closely with partners to create demand, unlock new revenue, improve customer outcomes, and bring the full value of Klaviyo to market.
Our best Partner Managers are commercial, partner-first, and highly collaborative. They turn strong executive relationships into measurable business outcomes through joint go-to-market planning, co-sell execution, partner recruitment, partner enablement, and strategic account development.

This is a senior, execution-focused strategic partnerships role supporting Klaviyo’s Mid/Large Enterprise motion across Asia. The role will help build and scale high-impact relationships with global and regional strategic partners, including Accenture, WPP, Hakuhodo, and Dentsu, while developing a broader partner ecosystem across Southeast Asia, Japan, Greater China, and South Korea.
Reporting to the APAC Partnerships Leader, you will identify, recruit, and grow strategic partnerships from the ground up. You will navigate complex, multi-threaded stakeholder environments and translate partner engagement into measurable pipeline, revenue, customer outcomes, and market expansion.
A key part of the role is building Klaviyo’s presence with partners that have strong enterprise reach, delivery capability, and influence across the target markets. Experience working with MSP and OSP models will be beneficial as we creatively explore how these partners can help bring Klaviyo’s next generation of AI-forward product capabilities to market.
You will articulate and differentiate Klaviyo in the market, drive business development and co-sell opportunities, and shape services-led go-to-market plays that help partners grow their Klaviyo practice and profitability. You will also work closely with Partner Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Success, and regional leadership to bring Klaviyo’s broader platform story to market, including our B2C CRM, AI-powered capabilities, and service offerings.
Strong martech experience is preferred but not required. More important is the ability to understand complex customer and partner environments, build credibility with senior stakeholders, and turn strategic relationships into repeatable commercial outcomes.
Focus markets
Southeast Asia (SEA)
Japan
Greater China (GCR)
South Korea
How you’ll make an impact
Lead the development and execution of Klaviyo’s strategic partnerships strategy across SEA, Japan, GCR, and South Korea.
Identify, recruit, and build high-impact partnerships with global and regional GSIs, SIs, agency holding companies, MSPs, OSPs, and other strategic services providers.
Develop and deepen relationships with priority partners such as Accenture, WPP, Hakuhodo, and Dentsu.
Build joint business plans that align partner priorities, Klaviyo’s growth objectives, target accounts, routes to market, and measurable revenue outcomes.
Create repeatable co-sell and partner-led motions across enterprise and upper mid-market accounts.
Own and grow a focused portfolio of strategic partners, with accountability for partner-sourced pipeline, partner-influenced revenue, activation, and market coverage.
Establish executive relationships across partner leadership, alliance teams, sales organisations, delivery teams, and relevant country or market leads.
Develop multi-partner plays that combine Klaviyo with GSIs, SIs, MSPs, OSPs, technology partners, and adjacent ecosystem partners to deliver differentiated customer value.
Partner closely with Sales to identify whitespace, map strategic accounts, create executive alignment, and accelerate complex opportunities.
Shape services-led and transformation-driven go-to-market plays that help partners build, scale, and monetise their Klaviyo practices.
Collaborate with Partner Marketing on regional campaigns, executive programs, events, and partner-led demand generation.
Work with Product, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Enablement to remove barriers to partner activation and customer adoption.
Bring Klaviyo’s broader platform story to partners and customers, including martech, AI, data, and service use cases.
Drive regular business reviews with strategic partners, using data and insight to improve performance, accountability, and long-term impact.
Travel across Asia, up to 25%, to meet partners, support field engagement, and attend strategic events.

You have 8+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, alliances, business development, enterprise sales, channel, or a related SaaS go-to-market role.
You have experience building and scaling high-value relationships with GSIs, SIs, agency holding companies, MSPs, OSPs, or broader services partners.
You have direct experience with partner recruitment, ideally taking partnerships from zero to one and creating the structure, momentum, and commercial case for growth.
You understand MSP and OSP operating models and how these partners influence technology decisions, customer relationships, implementation, and ongoing services.
You have a track record of driving partner-sourced, partner-influenced, or direct revenue outcomes against clear targets.
You are comfortable engaging senior executives across organisations such as Accenture, WPP, Hakuhodo, Dentsu, and comparable strategic partners.
You have experience working across multiple Asian markets and can adapt your approach to different business cultures, buying processes, and partner ecosystems.
You have a strong commercial mindset and know how to turn partner activity into pipeline, revenue, and strategic growth.
You are comfortable managing complex, multi-threaded relationships across external partners and internal cross-functional teams.
You have a strong understanding of SaaS sales motions, enterprise deal cycles, co-sell dynamics, and services-led growth.
You have experience building and executing joint go-to-market plans across co-sell, co-marketing, partner enablement, strategic accounts, and partner-led demand generation.

About Zscaler
Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. About Black Forest Labs
We’re the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we’re just getting started.
Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we’re scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.
Why This Role
Our models are already seeing strong inbound demand, and we’re expanding our commercial team to accelerate adoption across enterprise and strategic partners.
We’re looking for someone who can translate deep technical interest into durable, long-term partnerships especially across complex, non-standard engagements involving APIs, on-prem deployments, and custom licensing.
This role owns the end-to-end commercial journey, working closely with research, engineering, and leadership to help customers move confidently from evaluation to production.
What You’ll Work On
Own the full sales cycle from discovery through close and expansion across startups, scaleups, and enterprises
Run complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving technical buyers, executives, and legal teams
Design and execute sales motions across APIs, on-prem deployments, and custom licensing
Build durable customer relationships that drive retention and long-term expansion
Partner closely with solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineers, product, research, and legal on bespoke deals
Translate customer needs and market signals into actionable feedback for product and research
Help define early commercial processes, playbooks, and qualification frameworks as we scale

You’ve closed real, technically complex B2B deals and know how to operate without a playbook.
You bring strong judgment navigating long sales cycles, highly competitive environments with ambiguous requirements, and evolving products, and you’re comfortable working cross-functionally to get deals done the right way, not just quickly.

Experience selling technical products to tech executives, ML teams, and enterprise stakeholders
Ability to discuss model capabilities, inference requirements, and integration tradeoffs with technical buyers
Proven success managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing strategic landmark deals
Strong negotiation skills across pricing, licensing, and custom commercial terms
Track record building and scaling pipelines across different deal sizes and customer types
Comfort shaping process and structure in fast-moving, early-stage environments
How We Work Together
We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your role, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Weitersagen

Du baust gerne neue Märkte auf und überzeugst Menschen von digitalen Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert?

Dann könnte diese Rolle genau zu dir passen. Für unser SaaS-Produkt STRATUS suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende und vertriebsstarke Persönlichkeit, die den Markt in der Romandie aktiv weiterentwickelt, Neukund:innen gewinnt und langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufbaut. Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales Cycle – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss und darüber hinaus.

Das bewegst du

Als Business Development & Sales Manager:in entwickelst du den Markt für unser SaaS-Produkt STRATUS – unsere digitale Lösung für das Immobilienmanagement – in der Romandie aktiv weiter. Du identifizierst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, gewinnst Neukund:innen und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Dabei gestaltest du die Marktbearbeitung eigenverantwortlich und trägst wesentlich zum Wachstum unseres SaaS-Geschäfts bei.

Du führst den gesamten Sales Cycle eigenverantwortlich – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über die Bedarfsanalyse und die Präsentation unserer Softwarelösungen bis zur Erstellung von Angeboten, Vertragsverhandlungen und dem erfolgreichen Abschluss. Potenzielle Kund:innen überzeugst du telefonisch, digital, an Fachveranstaltungen sowie persönlich vor Ort. Dabei verstehst du ihre Herausforderungen und zeigst auf, wie unsere Lösungen einen echten Mehrwert für ihr Immobilienmanagement schaffen.

Auch nach dem Vertragsabschluss bleibst du eine wichtige Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen. Du begleitest die Einführung unserer Lösung, führst Anwenderschulungen durch und unterstützt eine erfolgreiche Nutzung von STRATUS. Gleichzeitig bringst du die Erkenntnisse aus dem Markt und aus Kundengesprächen aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Lösungen und unserer Marktbearbeitung ein.

Das bringst du mit

Du verfügst über mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb – idealerweise im Verkauf von Softwarelösungen oder anderen erklärungsbedürftigen Dienstleistungen – und hast Freude daran, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen und langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen. Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, Hartnäckigkeit und Abschlussstärke zeichnen dich aus. Du erkennst Chancen im Markt, gehst aktiv auf Menschen zu und verstehst es, Vertrauen nachhaltig aufzubauen.

Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Französisch und bewegst dich sicher im Geschäftsumfeld der Romandie. Die Businesskultur der Westschweiz ist dir vertraut, und du verstehst es, Beziehungen auf Augenhöhe aufzubauen. Deutschkenntnisse sind willkommen und erleichtern die Zusammenarbeit mit der Deutschschweiz.

Du arbeitest strukturiert, nutzt digitale Tools selbstverständlich und gehst Herausforderungen mit Eigeninitiative und einer pragmatischen Hands-on-Mentalität an. Eine Aus- oder Weiterbildung im Verkauf, in der Immobilienbranche oder im betriebswirtschaftlichen Umfeld ist von Vorteil. Idealerweise wohnst du im Drei-Seen-Land oder in den Kantonen Jura oder Waadt.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Wir sind ein unabhängiges Ingenieur-, Planungs- und Beratungsunternehmen und gestalten mit innovativen Lösungen die Zukunft in den Bereichen Bau, Mobilität, Energie und strategisches Portfoliomanagement. Im Fachbereich STRATUS erwartet dich Start-up-Spirit in einem etablierten Expertenumfeld – kollegial, wertschätzend und unkompliziert. Du übernimmst viel Eigenverantwortung und gestaltest den Aufbau unseres SaaS-Geschäfts in der Romandie aktiv mit.

Wir bieten dir ein Pensum von 50 bis 100 Prozent im Jahresarbeitszeitmodell sowie Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten nach der Einarbeitung. Das flexible Pensum eröffnet bewusst auch erfahrenen Persönlichkeiten sowie Wiedereinsteiger:innen – beispielsweise nach einer Familienzeit – attraktive Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten und mobilem Arbeiten lassen sich unterschiedliche Lebensmodelle gut mit dem Berufsalltag vereinbaren.

Darüber hinaus profitierst du von einer attraktiven Pensionskassenlösung, ÖV-Vergünstigungen wie GA oder Halbtax, einer Mensa beziehungsweise Cafeteria sowie regelmässigen Teamevents. Gezielte interne und externe Weiterbildungen unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Das zeichnet uns aus

Bei uns begegnen sich junge und erfahrene Fachpersonen auf Augenhöhe. Wir pflegen eine Kultur des gegenseitigen Respekts und eine unkomplizierte, prestigefreie Atmosphäre.

Als Team entwickeln wir unser SaaS-Produkt und unsere Marktbearbeitung kontinuierlich weiter. Wir teilen unser Wissen proaktiv, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und arbeiten eng zusammen, um für unsere Kund:innen praxisnahe digitale Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert zu entwickeln. Eigeninitiative, kurze Entscheidungswege und der Wille, gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein, prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit.

Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Platform Sales team works with B2B Software Platforms to help them facilitate payments for their customers using our Stripe Connect product. Software Platforms, also known as B2B Indirect, are software platform businesses who serve other businesses. Platforms already using Stripe include Shopify, Treatwell, Sage & Wix.
As a key member to the Stripe Platforms team, you will create, manage and elevate relationships with a named account list while identifying new growth opportunities and ways Stripe can exceed expectations.
If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

As an Account Executive, you will create partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing software platforms in the world by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments and financial services a competitive advantage for their businesses.

Directly prospect, manage and nurture a named account list and develop account plans for winning and expanding business with upper middle market and enterprise SaaS Platform companies
Develop and orchestrate key relationships with C-level executive
Own the full sales cycle from lead to close to activate to ramp
Work with company leaders from multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Product, and Finance) to lead complex product workshops and financial analysis
Craft and lead complex, bespoke commercial & contractual negotiations
Contribute to shaping our platform partnership strategy and building repeatable processes and scaled engagement models
Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process
Engage with Product and Engineering teams to help drive product strategy

You are an adept salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You have experience working with fast moving SaaS and ambitious SaaS companies and a deep understanding of the Israel market.

You have an in-depth understanding of the buyer journey and can lead a complex, multi-party sale in a highly consultative manner. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge.

You are naturally analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions. You get excited about prospecting, and are capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish.

Finally, you enjoy building – you like to actively participate in the development of our sales process, the articulation of our value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets.
If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

10+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a technical product, with a track record of top performance
Extensive experience directly selling a technology product or service, preferably at an API-first company, with a record of top performance
A proven track record of moving sales processes forward from inception to close by leading complex, multi-party sales in a highly consultative manner, understanding strategies and applying value proposition
Great listening skills and ability to quickly become a trusted resource for decision-makers across technology and finance orgs within software companies
An ability to understand complex technical problems and understand how Stripe’s solutions can address them
A positive attitude and tireless work ethic when encountering blockers to success, whether external or internal
Strong presentation skills
Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements
Superior verbal and written communication skills in Hebrew and English
Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space
Experience in or excitement in learning about financial technology infrastructure
Fastidious approach to CRM hygiene and experience utilizing thorough sales forecasting metrics on a weekly/quarterly basis and communicating them in a succinct manner

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
At DeepL, we're on an exciting adventure to expand our operations to match our ambitious growth plans. At the heart of this journey is our Sales team, a cornerstone of DeepL's market expansion and customer engagement strategy.
Our mission is clear: to build and develop high-performing sales teams that embody DeepL's innovative spirit and commitment to excellence. As a member of our Sales team, you will play a central role in growing our business and expanding our global reach into new markets. Working in close partnership with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams, you will collaborate to deliver tailored solutions that genuinely meet our clients' needs.
About this opportunity
We are looking for an exceptional sales professional based in Austria (preferable) OR Switzerland to establish and grow DeepL's presence in the Austrian market. This is a rare opportunity to build something meaningful in a market where we're just getting started.

You will be a key player in our Austrian expansion, bringing together an entrepreneurial approach with deep market knowledge — and you won't be doing it alone. You'll have the full support of an experienced, collaborative international team behind you.

Shape our Austrian market entry: You will be at the forefront of DeepL's expansion into Austria, introducing our market-leading translation services to clients and helping them break down language barriers
Build with purpose: Establish our sales foundation in Austria — creating processes, relationships, and market presence where little currently exists
Become a trusted market expert: Develop deep knowledge of the Austrian business landscape, cultural nuances, and customer needs to position DeepL as a valued and trusted solution
Represent and advocate: Serve as an expert on DeepL's products and your customers' needs, troubleshooting thoughtfully and resolving inquiries with care
Own the full sales cycle: As a trusted partner to new and incoming customers, you will qualify and convert leads and guide opportunities from first contact to close
Set and reach meaningful goals: Work towards monthly activity, pipeline, and revenue goals as we establish our presence in the market together
Cultivate a strong pipeline: Identify and develop new business opportunities, including upselling and cross-selling where it adds real value for clients
Manage diverse opportunities: Respond to inbound prospects and customers, navigating a varied mix of opportunities from qualification through to close
Stay organised and forward-looking: Track opportunity and customer details including use cases, timelines, and next steps to keep things moving smoothly
Connect across teams: Work closely with our diverse, international, and welcoming teams — from SDRs to Marketing — collaborating across borders with openness and curiosity
Qualities we look for
We know that confidence gaps and imposter syndrome can sometimes hold people back from applying. If you're excited about this role and feel you have most of what we're looking for, we'd genuinely love to hear from you — even if you don't tick every box.
Entrepreneurial mindset: You enjoy building from the ground up and feel energised by the challenge of creating something new. You're comfortable with ambiguity and motivated by the opportunity to make a real impact
Deep Austrian market knowledge: You have genuine knowledge and appreciation of Austrian business culture, market dynamics, and customer preferences — and you understand what makes the market unique
Cultural fluency: You connect authentically with Austrian clients and partners, and bring a genuine appreciation for local values and business practices
Solid full-cycle sales experience: A proven track record in Enterprise Sales with the ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals
SaaS expertise: Experience in software sales — especially SaaS — is preferred
Strong communication skills: Excellent organisation, presentation, and communication skills (verbal and written) across multicultural contexts
Adaptability and resilience: You feel comfortable in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment and can shift priorities while maintaining momentum
Collaborative spirit: You thrive when working as part of a team, enjoy supporting colleagues, and value cross-functional collaboration
Language proficiency: Fluent in both, German and English

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Remote work, flexible hours : we offer a remote work schedule for Austria , enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

NetBox Labs is seeking a Channel Account Manager (CAM) to play a key role in the growth and expansion of our partner business. You will report to the VP of Partnerships. Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to execute: drive NetBox Labs revenue by making our partners a force multiplier for our sales team.

That means hunting for partner opportunities, owning a partner-sourced pipeline, and expanding and deepening our existing partner relationships. This requires you to enable partner sellers to find, position, and win with NetBox Labs across our critical VAR, SI, and Technology Partner channels, from large national VARs to strong regional players.

We are looking for a hungry, high-energy doer; the person who makes things happen. The right candidate is a proven self-starter with initiative and self-sufficiency: someone who builds their own plan, creates their own momentum, and delivers results without waiting for direction.
Two things make this seat distinctive. First, the motion: this is a scaling business with real deal flow, a very active, fast-moving environment closing dozens of deals every quarter. As our platform adds new features and capabilities, we are winning larger and more complex enterprise deals.

You need to keep pace with today’s velocity and bring the experience to help us win upmarket. Second, the team: our sales organization is early in its career and growing fast. We need a CAM whose experience raises the whole team's game; co-selling, coaching deal strategy, and sharing hard-won channel craft.

Everything at NetBox Labs is new, and it changes daily. This role rewards curiosity, adaptability, and the commitment to put in the time to master our platform, our open source community, and our market. Experience here is a foundation to build on — never a playbook to coast on.
In this role you will
Hunt for revenue: prospect relentlessly for new opportunities within and alongside our partners; work with partner sellers and our sales organization to uncover, register, and advance deals in their account bases, bringing the same drive to partner-sourced pipeline that a top seller brings to net-new logos.
Selectively expand the partner portfolio: we are always open to new partners, especially large ones, but our team is lean and we qualify rigorously. Evaluate inbound and prospective partners with discipline, and work with the partner team to onboard only those that meaningfully strengthen our coverage.
Map and develop relationships within the Partner Field and Field Technical organizations: relentlessly discover new contacts, turn them into Champions for NetBox Labs, and convert those relationships into sales opportunities.
Own the number: build, forecast, and be accountable for a robust pipeline of Partner Sourced sales opportunities, and co-sell alongside our Account Executives to move deals from registration to close — at the pace our deal flow demands.
Coach as you close: co-sell with our Account Executives, run deal reviews, and share your channel knowledge and deal instincts that only experience teaches.
Drive joint go-to-market execution: build partner business plans, launch sales campaigns and enablement with partners, and hold both sides accountable for pipeline commitments.
Facilitate the effective and efficient interaction of NetBox Labs field and field technical teams with their counterparts at our partner organizations. Develop and maintain executive relationships with assigned Partners.
Learn relentlessly: invest the time to master the NetBox Labs platform, our open source ecosystem, and the network automation market — and keep learning as the product, the motion, and the market change week to week.
Keep Partner and Partner Deal information accurate and up to date within our CRM system. Provide accurate and timely reporting on key partner indicators and metrics.

Minimum of 3 – 5 years of channel sales experience, with a strong emphasis on managing Value-Added Resellers (VARs), SIs, Boutique consulting firms, and Technology partners in the B2B high-tech space (SaaS, networking, Infrastructure, cybersecurity, etc.).
Proven success in growing and managing a portfolio of partners with a measurable revenue impact: you can point to the pipeline you sourced and deals you helped close.
A strong sales orientation and hunter mentality: hungry, energetic, and treats partner recruitment and pipeline generation the way a quota-carrying seller treats their number.
A demonstrated self-starter who shows initiative and self-sufficiency: you thrive with autonomy, create your own structure, and do not need hand-holding to deliver results.
Range across deal types: you thrive in a very active, fast-moving, deal-rich environment, and you have the skills and mindset for larger, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals as that mix grows.
A coach’s mindset: genuine enjoyment in collaborating with sellers; you measure your impact in the team’s numbers, not just your own.
Learning agility: you quickly master new products, ecosystems, and markets, and you are energized, not exhausted, by an environment where everything is new and changes daily.
Start-up attitude: Ability to prioritize and act on the most important activities while working as a team to respond. Collaboration/coordination with your peers is the key to success. We are extremely fast paced.
Embrace AI: Leveraging AI to accelerate partnerships and add efficiency to your activities will be key. AI allows us to move / respond quickly.
In-depth understanding of partner business models, and sales cycles for a wide variety of partners.
Experience with partner tools including PRM systems, CRM (Hubspot preferred), and deal registration platforms.
Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills with the ability to influence Partner executives, sales reps, and technical stakeholders.

Experience across the VAR landscape, including large national VARs, regional VARs, and SI/Consulting partners.
Technical background or experience in networking, enterprise IT, cloud infrastructure, or security.
Startup experience at an organization experiencing hypergrowth.
Knowledge or background with partners in Networking, Network Engineering, and/or Network Automation would be a significant advantage.

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.
NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.
NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.
We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

Brafton is one of the world's leading content marketing firms, with offices in Boston, London, Toronto and Sydney. We aspire to continually raise the bar on what people consider "marketing content." We create result-focused strategies and content to drive SEO, social engagement and leads for our clients. Our teams continuously build expertise across new media formats, including video, blogs, infographics and web design.
This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity open to candidates in Eastern Time Zone Canada.
Build the Future of AI-Powered Marketing
We’re not building another AI writing tool.
At contentmarketing.ai , we’re redefining how marketing teams create content — combining AI-driven workflows across research, writing, QA, and SEO with real strategic rigor. The result: scalable, brand-aligned content that actually performs.
Backed by 18+ years of digital marketing expertise, Brafton has evolved from a leading content agency into a SaaS-driven business serving clients in 125+ countries.
We’re now scaling — and we’re looking for commercially driven Account Executives who understand both sales and modern marketing .

This is a quota-carrying, revenue-driving role focused on new business acquisition and account growth across small and mid-sized businesses.
You will own the full sales cycle — from inbound and outbound opportunity generation through to close — while also driving expansion within your accounts.
This is a high-activity, high-impact role , but success isn’t just about volume — it’s about understanding marketing challenges and clearly demonstrating ROI to marketing and business leaders.
You’ll engage directly with stakeholders across marketing and leadership teams, translating their goals (traffic, rankings, leads, pipeline, revenue) into scalable content strategies powered by contentmarketing.ai.
You should be confident, consultative, and commercially focused — able to build trust quickly, challenge when needed, and close decisively.
What You’ll Own
Full-cycle sales: prospecting, inbound conversion, closing, and expansion
Managing a high volume of opportunities across SMB and mid-market accounts
Running efficient, insight-driven discovery focused on marketing goals and performance gaps
Translating marketing challenges (SEO, content production, lead generation) into clear, ROI-driven solutions for both marketing and business leaders
Positioning contentmarketing.ai as a faster, smarter way to scale content and improve marketing performance
Driving upsell and renewal opportunities within existing accounts
Maintaining disciplined pipeline management and accurate forecasting in HubSpot
Structuring and closing commercial agreements (contracts, MSAs, addendums)

3 years of B2B sales experience in SaaS, digital marketing, or a similar space
Strong understanding of digital marketing concepts (SEO, content strategy, demand generation, or performance marketing)
Proven track record of hitting or exceeding quota in a high-volume sales environment
Experience managing multiple deals simultaneously with shorter sales cycles
Ability to engage credibly with marketing and business leaders and translate their goals into solutions
Comfortable running consultative sales conversations without overcomplicating the process
What Sets You Apart
You can speak the language of both marketers and commercial decision-makers
You connect product value directly to outcomes like traffic, leads, pipeline, and revenue
You balance speed with substance — moving deals forward while adding real insight
You build trust quickly and guide prospects toward decisions
You’re organized, detail-oriented, and disciplined in managing your pipeline
You bring energy, curiosity, and a strong desire to win
Why This Role
High-growth space: AI + marketing is scaling rapidly
Differentiated product: More than a writing tool — a structured content system
Real earning potential: Strong base + uncapped commission
Ownership: You control your pipeline and outcomes
Momentum: Join at a key stage of growth with real opportunity to scale with the business

Additional Information
Benefits Include: Competitive Incentive plan, Health Savings Account, pension, paid vacation, flexible remote schedule, and more!

Account Executive (US)
Affiliate & Influencer Marketing — Acceleration Partners

This is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners, a structure central to our culture and our vision to change the work/life paradigm. Occasional travel may be required for internal meetings or conferences. Applicants must be based in the U.S. in the Eastern or Central time zone.

We're looking for an Account Executive to manage and convert inbound demand for our Affiliate and Influencer Marketing Services. This is an operational, full-cycle closing role: our marketing team generates the leads, and you qualify, route, and run the sales process on the opportunities that come to you, taking deals under $250K in annual contract value from first conversation through signed contract yourself.
This is not a prospecting or outbound role; you won't be expected to build your own pipeline from scratch. Your focus is on being an excellent steward of the leads we generate: qualifying quickly and accurately, routing anything outside your scope to the right owner, and running a tight, credible sales process across a steady flow of inbound opportunities.

Inbound Lead Management & Qualification: Own the intake of inbound leads generated by our marketing team. Qualify each opportunity quickly and accurately, and route anything outside your scope (by deal size or segment) to the right owner.
Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Manage qualified deals under $250K ACV from first contact through close, including negotiation and contracting. Own the timeline and keep the process moving.
Consultative Program Strategy: Ask the right questions, understand each prospect's business challenges, and build the strategic recommendation yourself, showing how Affiliate and Influencer Marketing can drive measurable growth for their business.
Pitch Delivery & Presentation: Present your recommendation directly to the prospect. You're the face of the strategy in the room; marketing and sales support can help with collateral and modeling, but the pitch is yours to deliver.
Pipeline Discipline & Subject Matter Expertise: Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting on your book of inbound opportunities, and stay current on the Affiliate and Influencer Marketing space so you're a credible, trusted advisor to every prospect you engage.

Sales Experience
Demonstrated track record of closing deals under $250K in annual contract value, owning the strategic pitch yourself without handing it off
Comfortable managing a fast-moving, full sales cycle, sometimes with multiple stakeholders, sometimes with a single decision-maker
Experience selling into marketing or ecommerce departments at growing or mid-sized companies is a strong plus
Digital Marketing Knowledge
Deep understanding of the digital marketing space, with specific knowledge in one or more of: Affiliate / Influencer, customer acquisition strategy, revenue growth marketing, mobile marketing, CRM and lifecycle marketing, or ecommerce growth channels
Ability to speak credibly with marketing buyers about performance, measurement, and channel strategy, since you're building and delivering that argument yourself
Technical & Tools Proficiency
Salesforce, required; HubSpot an advantage
AI fluency, using AI tools to work smarter in research, proposal development, or pipeline management
Proficient in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Independent, Full-Cycle Selling
Comfortable owning a deal solo, from qualified inbound lead through signed contract, pulling in marketing or sales support for collateral and modeling but not reliant on anyone else to carry the narrative
Strong time management and prioritization across a steady flow of inbound opportunities
Sharp qualification instincts and good judgment about what to route elsewhere
Mature judgment, adaptability, and the ability to solve problems independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment
AI fluent and committed to continuous improvement

3+ years of digital marketing or marketing services sales experience
Demonstrated experience closing full-cycle deals independently, without dedicated strategy or account management support
Experience selling into marketing and/or ecommerce departments at mid-sized or growing brands
Experience managing and qualifying inbound lead flow
Salesforce required; HubSpot an advantage
A genuine interest in AI tools, including hands-on experience integrating AI into your work
Must be based in the US in the Eastern or Central time zone

By 3 Months… You're fully up to speed on Acceleration Partners' value proposition, services, and sales process. You're efficiently qualifying and routing inbound leads, running full sales cycles solo on your qualified opportunities, and can position our managed services against client needs without help building the pitch.
By 1 Year… You've closed multiple deals sourced through inbound flow, contributed to sales process improvements, sharpened how leads get qualified and routed, and built a reputation as a seller who can run a deal from first inbound conversation to signature on your own.

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business.

Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.
By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more.

Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations.

With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

As an Commercial Account Executive on our Commercial team you'll be responsible for seeking out new opportunities within both new logos and our existing customer base. You will have experience prospecting, running discovery calls/demos, negotiating, and a track record of closing new business.

You should also understand use cases and how to sell across multiple departments and industries. To be successful in this role you will understand how to go after new business and build relationships with potential customers. Intrigued? We want to speak to you!

Manage the entire sales cycle, which includes prospecting, conducting discovery calls and demos, negotiating deals, and closing new & existing business across all industries in the Small Medium Business segment (1-2000 employees).
Conduct thorough research to understand your customers and prospects better. Gain insight into their unique business challenges and how Box can provide value.
Drive the sales process by influencing key stakeholders both internally and externally.
Develop a comprehensive territory plan that covers all aspects of your target market.
Schedule visits to meet customers face-to-face within your assigned territory if you feel appropriate

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.
Fluent German speaker
2+ years of experience in a sales role, with a proven track record of success - We're interested if you've been in inside sales too!
Strong hunter with demonstrated pipeline generation creativity (events, social selling, automation tools).
Skilled in qualification and deal progression frameworks (MEDDIC familiarity helpful; outcome-focused mindset essential).
Curiosity and eagerness to learn about Box’s product, new technologies, the industry, and your customer's businesses
Clear examples of successfully closing deals using an established sales process
Effectively utilizes a repeatable method for identifying untapped opportunities and expanding into new territories
Previous experience in building relationships and selling to executives at all level
Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.
Based on current business needs, there is no relocation assistance provided for this role.
At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head-over-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!

Box Benefits package includes 30 days of vacation, medical, and dental coverage. We have a robust wellness program including 30 days of vacation (plus your birthday off!) and subsidized gym membership. Boxers can also participate in our Employee Stock Purchase plan and other additional perks and benefits. Germany's office is based in a WeWork (Neuturmstrasse 5, Munich, BY 80331,) as well as other European offices across London, Paris, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

About SINGU
At SINGU , we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.
Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide , supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.
Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.
If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.
The Opportunity
This is a pure new business role. You own a defined territory and named-account set, the pipeline you create within it, and the commercial outcome of every deal you run, from first conversation to signature.
The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, six to nine months, with typical initial values of £25k- £100k and clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning takes a business case, not a demonstration and it requires strong discovery, quantified value, access to senior decision-makers and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT and finance.
Singu supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product and senior executive support, not an unproven proposition.
Why Strong Sellers Join Singu
A defined territory and named-account set, not an undifferentiated geographic patch.
Enterprise deals with meaningful initial value and clear multi-country expansion potential.
Dedicated business development, Pre-Sales, marketing and executive sponsorship.
Direct access to the CRO for deal strategy, coaching and fast commercial decisions. Pricing, terms and sponsorship all take place without a committee.
Uncapped earnings with meaningful accelerators for over-performance.
Credible routes into strategic or global accounts or sales leadership.
What You Will Own
Pipeline and Coverage
A new business quota, and a territory plan that shows how you intend to hit it.
Pipeline built through business development, marketing, partner and self-generated activity, with personal responsibility for coverage across the territory.
Diagnostic conversations grounded in operating cost, compliance and risk.
Deal Execution
Opportunities qualified to a MEDDICC standard, with a quantified business case and access to the economic buyer.

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains.

Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Enterprise Account Executive to join our Marketplaces sales team. Branch is a leader in the marketplace payments space, with some of the largest labor and delivery marketplaces in the world — including Uber and Instacart — among our largest customers.

In this role, you will be responsible for driving new business acquisition and revenue growth by selling our innovative FinTech solutions to enterprise-level clients.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of managing complex sales cycles, building strong relationships with C-level executives, and a deep understanding of the financial services industry.

Own and manage a named book of enterprise and upper‐mid‐market labor and seller marketplace clients to build strategic relationships at C-suite, VP, and director levels.
Lead full sales cycles, from inbound and outbound prospecting through contract negotiation and closing.
Partner closely with our embedded payments platform partner's sales organization to jointly identify, pursue, and manage shared accounts — driving co-sell and cross-sell opportunities and enabling their sellers to effectively position Branch within their deals.
Develop and execute comprehensive account plans to win new business and expand with existing clients.
Work cross‐functionally across Product, Finance, and Engineering to design and deliver custom solutions as part of a technical selling process.
Drive and refine the marketplace strategy: help define and scale repeatable engagement models, sales motions, and positioning for Branch’s platform offerings.

Collaborate with internal teams to shape product roadmap based on client feedback, competitive landscape, and market demand.
Hit or exceed revenue targets, sales quotas, and other KPIs relevant to platform and enterprise deals.

Have strong product acumen and are capable of understanding and communicating both technical and financial value.
Are highly analytical — you know how to build business cases, model ROI, and use data to drive decisions.
Are self-motivated, resourceful, and can thrive in a fast‐moving environment that requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
Are excellent communicators, both written and verbal.

Previous experience in fintech, embedded finance, or payments infrastructure.
Experience selling into or working with HR technology and vertical SaaS platforms.
Familiarity with risk, regulatory, and compliance considerations in financial services.

Obsidian Security is the leading SaaS security platform, trusted by global enterprises like Snowflake, T-Mobile, and Algolia. We protect 200+ organizations across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, including many of the world’s largest Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 companies.
Founded in 2017 and backed by top investors like Greylock, Obsidian was built to close a critical gap: securing SaaS apps where business happens—Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and hundreds more. The company does this by offering a complete SaaS security platform to reduce risk, detect and respond to threats, and prevent breaches at the source.

Obsidian was built by leaders who redefined endpoint and identity security at CrowdStrike, Okta, Cylance, and Carbon Black. Now, they’re transforming how SaaS is secured.
With AI driving rapid SaaS growth and complexity, agentic AI tools gain privileged access to sensitive data through integrations, creating new risks most security tools miss. Obsidian uniquely detects anomalous OAuth token activity and manages integration risks. Major announcements are on the horizon. Recognizing that SaaS security needs to evolve, Obsidian enables growing organizations to start with a lightweight, prevention-focused browser extension and expand coverage over time.
With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and a major fundraise ahead, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T.

Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You'll work closely with our VC and Community partnerships team to engage Seed-Series A startups, proactively source and outbound high-potential businesses, and ensure a seamless onboarding experience.

You'll educate founders on our full product suite, enabling them to build their billing engine from scratch on the Airwallex platform. You'll also embed Airwallex in the startup community by attending events, hosting roundtables, and building our brand across the ecosystem.
