s.h: AT NDI , THE WORK YOU DO HERE MAKES A DIFFERENCE.
s.t:
Every day, we help shape the future of healthcare. We design and build 3D tracking systems that equip medical devices with advanced spatial navigation technology, delivering greater accuracy, performance, and confidence in procedures where precision is critical.

Since 1981, we’ve partnered with leading OEMs and research institutes to push the boundaries of surgical navigation. Our optical and electromagnetic technologies are trusted in procedures ranging from orthopedics and spine surgery to cardiac interventions and radiation therapy.
Whether you're designing systems, supporting customers, or enabling the teams behind them, your work matters. It brings clarity to healthcare and helps improve outcomes for patients around the world.

The OEM Business Development Manager, Surgical (internally known as Business Manager – Surgical OEM) is responsible for driving profitable growth within a defined medical market segment through strategic account expansion, business development, and market leadership.
As NDI 's commercial lead for the assigned market, you will develop deep expertise in customer applications, industry trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging technologies. You will leverage these insights to identify new opportunities, expand OEM partnerships, and influence long-term growth strategies.
Success in this role requires a combination of technical credibility, commercial acumen, and relationship-building skills. You will engage with engineering, product management, clinical, procurement, and executive stakeholders to advance opportunities from concept through commercialization. This role is ideal for a technically minded commercial professional who enjoys creating new opportunities while growing long-term customer partnerships.

Own the commercial performance of a defined medical market segment, including revenue growth, retention, pipeline development, and market expansion.
Develop deep expertise in assigned markets, including customer applications, industry trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging technologies.
Build and maintain strong relationships with engineering, product management, clinical, procurement, and executive stakeholders across OEM customers.
Identify, qualify, and advance new programs, product platforms, and strategic growth opportunities within existing and prospective customers.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities aligned to market growth objectives.
Develop and execute account and market growth strategies that expand NDI 's participation across customer programs, business units, and product roadmaps.
Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, and Applications Engineering teams to translate market insights into commercial opportunities.
Lead pricing discussions, actively participate in commercial negotiations, and long-term partnership agreements.
Represent the voice of the customer and market internally to support business and product strategy.
Support compliance by adhering to applicable regulatory and quality standards, ensuring product integrity and patient safety in a global medical device environment.

Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Engineering, Life Sciences, Business, or a related discipline.
6+ years of experience in technical sales, business development, strategic account management, product management, applications engineering, or related customer-facing roles.
Demonstrated success creating new business opportunities while growing existing customer relationships.
Experience supporting technically complex products or solutions within medical devices, healthcare technology, robotics, navigation, imaging, or OEM environments.
Direct experience working with medical device OEM customers is strongly preferred.
Strong technical aptitude with the ability to engage credibly with engineering and product development teams.
Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales and product development environments.
Proven ability to identify, qualify, and advance opportunities from early-stage engagement through commercialization.
Strong business acumen, relationship management, negotiation, and strategic planning skills.
Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

As a Canada, Public Sector Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI across the Canadian public sector.

You'll leverage your deep understanding of Canadian government operations and consultative sales expertise to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to customers, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities.

In collaboration with GTM, product, and marketing teams, you'll help refine our approach to the Canadian public-sector market while maintaining the highest standards of security and compliance.

This is a national role anchored in the National Capital Region, supporting the Government of Canada, provincial/territorial governments, Canada's national security and defence community, crown corporations, and the broader public sector.

Drive new business and revenue growth across the Canadian public sector, with the Government of Canada as the primary focus and provincial/territorial governments, crown corporations, and the broader public sector as secondary coverage, owning the full sales cycle from initial outreach through deployment
Navigate how the Government of Canada buys cloud and AI services, including software licensing supply arrangements, federal cloud brokering, resale through Canadian partners, consumption via cloud provider marketplaces, competitive tendering, and Indigenous procurement considerations
Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers across the Government of Canada, including departmental Chief Information Officers and Chief Data Officers, senior program executives, central agency and procurement stakeholders, and mission owners, becoming a trusted advisor on AI capabilities and implementation
Develop and execute strategic account plans that align with departmental mandates and modernization initiatives, positioning Anthropic early in major programs to shape requirements before they are finalized
Navigate Canadian security and compliance requirements, including data classification levels, federal security control profiles, assessment and authorization, data-residency requirements, and personnel security clearances
Coordinate closely with cloud service providers and system integrators to ensure successful deployment and integration
Represent Anthropic at Canadian public-sector and partner events, including industry days, conferences, and cloud provider events, raising Anthropic's profile through speaking engagements and community engagement
Provide detailed market intelligence and customer feedback to product teams to ensure our offerings meet Canadian public-sector requirements, including responsible-AI obligations under the Treasury Board Directive on Automated Decision-Making and the Algorithmic Impact Assessment
Create and maintain sales playbooks specific to Canadian public-sector use cases and procurement processes
Generate pipeline and own territory and account planning across your assigned Canadian public-sector accounts, maintaining hands-on engagement with key accounts
Collaborate across teams to ensure coordinated delivery of commitments and maintain appropriate documentation of customer engagements, engaging bilingually (English/French) with federal institutions and Quebec public-sector customers where required

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity.

World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes.

We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Fast-track your growth in enterprise sales through our exclusive top talent program. Stay current on AI trends, process automation, and digital transformation to position Celonis as the intelligent backbone of enterprise operations.

2–3 years of professional experience in a client-facing role, ideally at a top-tier management consultancy, a corporate strategy or transformation function, or a leading enterprise technology company.
A strong academic background in Business Economics, Engineering, Informatics, or a related field. A graduate degree (Master’s, MBA, etc.) from an accredited institution is preferred.

About Faire
Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline.

At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores.

With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

Faire's quality, depth, and breadth of brands is its strongest value to retailers. Our Brand Partnerships team is at the forefront of Faire's success, ensuring that the best and most relevant brands join and thrive on our platform.
As a Account Executive (L2B), you will be a trusted advisor to Upmarket brands across Spain, helping them unlock wholesale growth on Faire and driving incremental GMV at scale.
This role is a blend of strategic thinking and high-velocity sales execution. You will own a portfolio of brands across your geos, proactively identifying and activating the best-fit brands for Faire. You bring a strong commercial mindset comfortable from C-level to operational stakeholder and you use AI, data, and sharp instincts to outperform.
We are looking for a stellar performer: someone who has finished top 3 in their org, qualified for President's Club or All-Stars, and is hungry to do it again in a market that is genuinely early and genuinely exciting.
You're excited about this opportunity because...
You have been top of the leaderboard before and you want to do it in a market that isn't fully built yet, where your territory becomes the foundation others inherit
You are energised by fast-moving, ambiguous environments and see AI as a genuine force multiplier, not a buzzword
You want to sell something that actually matters, levelling the playing field for independent retailers against e-commerce and big-box giants is a mission you can get behind
You want to work alongside a tight-knit team of high performers who share wins loudly, debug losses together, and hold themselves to a standard most sales teams only talk about
You are curious by default, you dig until you understand, and you bring that intellectual rigour to every deal

Identify and win the right opportunities
Manage a book of business across Spain with the goal of maximizing the incremental GMV that new Upmarket brands bring to the Faire platform
Set your own sub-targets, hold yourself accountable, and know exactly what levers to pull when performance is under pressure
Use business data, category insights, AI-powered tooling, and your own market knowledge to build a pipeline that is both high volume and high quality

Lead a best-in-class upmarket sales cycle
Lead every customer interaction with a personalized, insight-led approach, understanding each brand's unique business and shaping Faire's value proposition to their specific problems
Navigate multi-threaded deals with confidence: from C-suite vision conversations to operational onboarding with sales and marketing teams

Understand how competitors and industry players operate and articulate Faire's key differentiators with precision
Research trends, industry events, and key account signals across Spain, and bring that intelligence back to sharpen team strategy
Represent Faire across the wholesale industry
Drive Faire's value props and messaging across the full sales surface: outreach, nurture, tradeshows, events, and in-person brand visits
Identify and pursue new business opportunities that drive incremental revenue for the platform

Our Senior Ecosystem Sales Manager (ESM) will be based in Mumbai or Delhi. This is a senior, market-facing role responsible for building and scaling GitLab's partner business in India across the full breadth of the ecosystem: hyperscalers, large India-centric system integrators (SIs), and born-in-the-cloud / AI-native partners.

We are looking for someone with the range and seniority to credibly own strategic partner relationships across all of these partner types, and to help grow our business through these partners.
This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who has already built a career scaling partner-sourced and influenced revenue in India — someone who knows the hyperscaler ecosystem (AWS & GCP), has deep, credible relationships with India's major SIs, and understands how to engage newer-generation cloud-native and AI partners as they become an increasingly important part of the go-to-market.

Build and scale GitLab's partner-sourced and influence business in India across hyperscalers, large India-centric SIs, and born-in-the-cloud/AI partners.
Develop deep, strategic (not transactional) relationships with a focused set of priority partners — joint business plans, QBRs, and named executive sponsorship.
Own hyperscaler relationship management and Marketplace motion with AWS and/OR GCP.
Build and grow relationships with major India SIs and market-making channel/born-in-the-cloud partners and emerging AI-native partners.
Drive partner-sourced pipeline and bookings, and carry a quota tied to partner-sourced/generated revenue.
Partner closely with the India sales team to ensure partner-sourced opportunities are properly identified, supported, and closed.
Work with the India and APJ Ecosystem team to help shape and refine the India Ecosystem coverage model.
Contribute to partner enablement, certification, and go-to-market programs suited to the India market.
Report on partner engagement health, pipeline contribution, and progress against strategic-partner milestones.

15+ years of experience in channel/alliance/partner management or ecosystem sales, ideally within enterprise software, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure.
Extensive, well-rounded experience scaling a business through partners across hyperscalers, large India-centric SIs, and born-in-the-cloud/AI-native partners — not narrowly specialized in just one partner type.
Direct experience managing hyperscaler relationships (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure) including Marketplace motion.
A strong, credible existing network among India's major SIs and cloud-native/channel partners, with a track record of moving relationships from transactional to strategic.
Comfort carrying a partner-sourced revenue quota and being measured on pipeline origination, not just deal closure.
Strong stakeholder management skills — able to align internal sales, marketing, and partner-side stakeholders around joint goals.
Native or business-fluent Indiaese and strong business English (for regional collaboration with APJ leadership).
Based in or willing to relocate to Mumbai OR Delhi.

Prior experience at or with a hyperscaler (AWS, GCP) in a partner or alliances capacity.
Familiarity with GitLab, DevSecOps, or adjacent developer-tooling ecosystems.
Experience helping design or reset a partner coverage model, comfortable building process rather than only inheriting one.
What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)
Joint business plans and an active engagement cadence (e.g., QBRs) in place across priority hyperscaler, SI, and cloud-native/AI partners.
Demonstrable movement of key partner relationships from transactional to strategic engagement.
Growing partner-sourced pipeline and bookings against quota.
Credible input into finalizing the India Ecosystem coverage model, grounded in on-the-ground partner relationships.

At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!
As a SMB Account Manager, you are responsible for retaining and growing a defined portfolio of existing customers in the US market. You act as the commercial owner of each relationship — driving renewals, expanding accounts, and positioning Trustpilot as a long-term partner that delivers measurable business value.
You combine commercial acumen with relationship depth, collaborating closely with Customer Success Managers to ensure adoption, satisfaction, and sustainable revenue growth.
You are accountable for contributing to strong Gross Renewal Rate (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) results by executing defined renewal processes, maintaining Salesforce accuracy, and supporting customers to achieve measurable value.

Retention & Renewal: Own the end-to-end renewal process, delivering high Gross Renewal Rates (GRR) and predictable retention.
Growth & NRR: Drive portfolio expansion through upsell and cross-sell to achieve strong Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and overall portfolio growth.
Account Planning: Build and maintain detailed account plans, stakeholder maps, and accurate forecasts in Salesforce.
Customer Engagement: Lead commercial and strategic conversations, including business reviews and contract discussions.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Customer Success to ensure value realization, with Marketing on customer stories, and with Product on feedback loops.
Operational Excellence: Ensure accurate data, forecasting discipline, and pipeline visibility across your portfolio.

You have experience in account management, renewals, or a similar customer-facing role within a SaaS or subscription-based company.
Strong understanding of retention, NRR, upsell, and cross-sell motions.
Solid commercial awareness with the ability to link product value to customer outcomes.
Skilled at managing a large portfolio and keeping accurate account data in CRM systems.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills.
Comfortable analysing account performance data and forecasting renewals.
Able to work cross-functionally and thrive in a fast-moving, target-driven environment.
A good understanding of the digital advertising/search marketing industry – preferred.

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.
Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.
We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.
Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

About Tekmetric
Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.
Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.
Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.
But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.
Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.
Working the Tekmetric Way
At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.
We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.
We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.
Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.
At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection . We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.

About Halter
At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences.

Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance.

Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.
We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .
To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .

This is a rare opportunity to be one of Halter's first Regional Sales Managers (Sudoeste), Argentina — one of the world's great cattle nations — building our customer presence in the region from the ground up.
We're looking for a go-getter who is out in the field, meeting farmers, championing Halter and converting them into our very first local customers. A 'never give up attitude' is crucial for this role; as our first sales hire on the ground, you will be a foundational contributor to the growth and success of Halter in Argentina.
You'll be responsible for using your strong sales background to drive end-to-end sales, from cold calling and on-farm meetings to deeply understanding our customers' farm systems. You'll detail Halter's value proposition, progress the sale, and ultimately close the deal.

As the region scales, you'll help shape how we set quotas and commissions, build sales capability, and mentor the team that follows you. Make your mark with Halter and help us push the boundaries of farming, connecting animals and humans like never before.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals/introductions, industry events and other channels, as well as fielding and responding to inbound inquiries.
Meeting high growth sales targets by managing pipeline through to close, including screening, qualifying, executing on-farm demonstrations and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.
Laying the groundwork for the local sales function — helping to set and manage quotas, commissions and other sales management tasks as the team grows.
Coaching, mentoring and developing future sales staff to help drive their professional growth and reach targets as we scale the region.
Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal.
Providing support, insight and communication to help build and foster trusting and enduring relationships with customers as they wait for deployment.
Leveraging opportunities and participating in relevant industry/Halter events and demonstrations.
Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand in a brand-new market.
Focusing on the customer and their needs, providing feedback to help drive the product roadmap.
Working with the team to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient and more predictable as the company scales.

A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience.
Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities.
Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results.
Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition.
Experience in beef farming or within the agricultural sector is highly desirable.
A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills.
Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet — comfort with the ambiguity of building in a new market is a big plus.

s.h: Sales experience in the technology-based industry is preferred.
s.t:
Fluency in Spanish, with professional working English to collaborate across our global team.
A university degree or equivalent would be excellent but not a must.
Halter in Argentina
Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.
Join our team
Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement.

If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!
If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!
Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram .

s.h: Why our team loves working at Halter
s.t:
Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.
Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.
You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.
This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

This is a rare opportunity to be one of Halter's first Regional Sales Managers (Oeste Arenoso), Argentina — one of the world's great cattle nations — building our customer presence in the region from the ground up.
We're looking for a go-getter who is out in the field, meeting farmers, championing Halter and converting them into our very first local customers. A 'never give up attitude' is crucial for this role; as our first sales hire on the ground, you will be a foundational contributor to the growth and success of Halter in Argentina.
You'll be responsible for using your strong sales background to drive end-to-end sales, from cold calling and on-farm meetings to deeply understanding our customers' farm systems. You'll detail Halter's value proposition, progress the sale, and ultimately close the deal.

As the region scales, you'll help shape how we set quotas and commissions, build sales capability, and mentor the team that follows you. Make your mark with Halter and help us push the boundaries of farming, connecting animals and humans like never before.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals/introductions, industry events and other channels, as well as fielding and responding to inbound inquiries.
Meeting high growth sales targets by managing pipeline through to close, including screening, qualifying, executing on-farm demonstrations and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.
Laying the groundwork for the local sales function — helping to set and manage quotas, commissions and other sales management tasks as the team grows.
Coaching, mentoring and developing future sales staff to help drive their professional growth and reach targets as we scale the region.
Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal.
Providing support, insight and communication to help build and foster trusting and enduring relationships with customers as they wait for deployment.
Leveraging opportunities and participating in relevant industry/Halter events and demonstrations.
Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand in a brand-new market.
Focusing on the customer and their needs, providing feedback to help drive the product roadmap.
Working with the team to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient and more predictable as the company scales.

A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience.
Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities.
Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results.
Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition.
Experience in beef farming or within the agricultural sector is highly desirable.
A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills.
Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet — comfort with the ambiguity of building in a new market is a big plus.

s.h: Sales experience in the technology-based industry is preferred.
s.t:
Fluency in Spanish, with professional working English to collaborate across our global team.
A university degree or equivalent would be excellent but not a must.
Halter in Argentina
Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. We’re looking for a driven, high-performing Account Manager to join the momentum and help shape the future of farming in the South Auckland region. This is an opportunity to positively disrupt an industry and pioneer groundbreaking change, working with some of the highest-performing dairy farms in New Zealand.

Serving as the primary point-of-contact for Halter customers, you will be passionate about driving farmer success for one of the world’s fastest-growing companies that will transform how they farm to become leaders in productivity and sustainability.

You will be backed by a team of exceptional people on the ground in the North Island and at Halter’s Auckland HQ, to ensure this is the best job you’ll ever have.
Location - This role is to be based anywhere in the South Auckland / North Waikato region. Frequent travel is required as part of the position.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Revenue Retention & Expansion: You will own the retention, renewals and expansion targets of Halter’s existing revenue in the region.
Ensure farmers are extracting full value from Halter to achieve their goals and ultimately understand the impact it’s having on their farming business.
Account Management: Responsible for renewing customer agreements and expanding the revenue of existing Halter customers, by adding value in every interaction to drive on-farm goals and performance.
Deployment: Supporting the onboarding, training and implementation of the Halter system on customers' farms, ensuring all relevant farm owners, managers, and workers are able to successfully use the system.
Relationship Building: Proactively cultivate genuine and trustworthy relationships with farmers, their teams, and families, fostering strong connections and understanding.
Farmer Success: Strategically partnering with customers to establish clear business goals, timelines, priorities and metrics of success.
Problem-Solving: Provide prompt and effective communication and support to farmers and team members, addressing technical or operational challenges with expertise and efficiency.
Community & Networking: Represent the Halter brand with pride, lead local discussion groups, and proactively build strong networks within the community for increased brand visibility and connections.
Customer Advocate: Acting as the voice of the customer and bridging the gap with our product teams to provide important context about what is happening on the ground with our farmers and their animals.
Technical Expertise : Working closely with our product teams to provide technical and practical advice from a farmer’s perspective on everything reproduction, pasture and agronomy.
Contribute to a positive team environment, supporting others to succeed and role modelling Halter’s Operating Principles.
Who we’re looking for: We’re backing potential over polish. These are the traits that matter most:
A great human first
You bring integrity, humility, and care. You do what you say you’ll do. You show up for your farmers and your teammates.
Lifelong learner mindset
You’re genuinely curious. You ask questions, seek feedback, and are excited to keep levelling up alongside a world‑class team.
Hunger and grit
You love chasing ambitious goals, solving hard problems, and sticking with it when things get tough.
Positive energy and team spirit
You lift the people around you, not drain them. You enjoy collaborating, sharing ideas, and celebrating others’ wins as much as your own.
Comfort in a fast‑moving environment
You’re at your best when things are dynamic. You can work autonomously, manage your time well, and stay focused on what matters most.
The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment with a high degree of autonomy.
A hunger for success and personal growth, and an eagerness to evolve alongside a world-class team.
And these pieces give you an advantage, but are not a prerequisite:
3-5 years of experience in relationship management/account management roles.
Experience in dairy farming or within the agriculture sector with a deep passion for helping farmers succeed.
Strong business and commercial acumen

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.
With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.
Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement.

We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

This is your chance to build Mollie's presence in Denmark from the ground up, as the first person hired with this market as your sole focus. You won't be starting from zero: you'll have the Nordic foundation already built in Sweden to work from, but the Danish playbook is yours to write.
You'll open the market, land our first Danish customers, and turn early learnings into a repeatable approach we can scale. It's a broader, more entrepreneurial scope than a standard sales role. You'll work deals from $100K a month while building toward bigger opportunities of up to $1 million a month, all while shaping how Mollie understands and enters this market for the long run.
What makes this role stand out is the mix: outbound selling, customer discovery, partnerships, and competitive analysis, all rolled into one seat with real ownership. If you want to build something rather than maintain something, this is that opportunity.
What you'll ship
Run outbound sales and manage the full sales process, including around 20 cold calls a week
Build a Danish pipeline and land Mollie's first customers in the market
Gather market feedback and grow larger opportunities, including deals of up to $1 million a month
Build relationships with Danish agencies and work on partnerships alongside the partner manager based in Stockholm
Share what you learn about the Danish marketing landscape with the marketing team to help shape events and go-to-market plans
Run competitive analysis to sharpen how Mollie positions itself in Denmark

Around 5 years of full-cycle sales experience, with a strong outbound track record and demonstrated success in structured cold outreach
Value selling capability, with a data-driven approach to activity and pipeline management
Strong negotiation and contract handling skills, including experience communicating and negotiating with C-level stakeholders
Creativity in building a pipeline through partnerships or marketing outreach (you don't need to have done this before, just show the potential)
Experience in payments, fintech, or SaaS sales, built across multiple companies
Comfortable working hands-on in a role with broad scope and real uncertainty
Fluency in Danish

The Partnerships team supports OpenAI’s mission by building and managing external relationships that expand product reach, accelerate adoption, strengthen strategic capabilities, and help the company scale responsibly. We partner across the organization to develop a go to market ecosystem strategy, create shared value, and support relationships that are critical to OpenAI’s growth.

We’re looking for a Partnerships Sales Manager to lead high-impact co-sell relationships across our go to market sales teams and our system integrators and solution partners. You’ll manage a portfolio of strategic external partners—including technology platforms, distribution channels, service providers, and other ecosystem partners—and work closely with internal sales teams to turn business needs into effective partnership strategies in order to deliver customer value and outcomes.
This role combines relationship management, commercial judgment, and hands-on execution. You’ll help evaluate new partners, negotiate agreements, improve existing programs, and create the operating mechanisms needed to manage partnerships at scale.
This role is based in New York in office 3 days a week.
In this role, you will
Own and deepen relationships with key strategic and ecosystem partners.
Drive a partner first strategy across your assigned field territory alongside GTM teams
Develop partnership strategies aligned with OpenAI’s product, go-to-market, and operational priorities.
Source, evaluate, and onboard new partners and service providers.
Lead commercial negotiations in partnership with Legal, Business Operations, Procurement, Security, and other stakeholders.
Translate complex business requirements into clear partner selection criteria and operating plans.
Establish performance metrics, governance processes, and regular business reviews for strategic relationships.
Identify opportunities to improve economics, service quality, resilience, and scalability across the partner portfolio.
Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving Sales, Product, Engineering, Legal, Security, Marketing, Business Operations, and other partner-facing teams.
Monitor market developments, ecosystem shifts, and emerging capabilities across relevant partner categories.
Prepare recommendations and decision materials for senior leaders.
Anticipate partnership risks and lead their resolution with internal and external stakeholders.
You might thrive in this role if you
Have 7+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, ecosystem development, platform partnerships, go-to-market alliances, or a related field.
Have direct sales and/or sales overlay experience.
Have managed complex relationships with technology platforms, distribution partners, service providers, infrastructure companies, or other critical strategic partners.
Are an effective negotiator with strong commercial instincts and experience structuring sophisticated agreements.
Can analyze commercial and operational data and turn it into clear recommendations.
Work well across technical, commercial, legal, go-to-market, and operational teams.
Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, setting priorities, and building new processes in a fast-moving environment.
Communicate clearly with executives, partners, and subject-matter experts.
Pair strategic thinking with a willingness to own detailed execution.
Exercise excellent judgment when working with confidential or sensitive information.

Experience supporting a rapidly scaling global technology company.
Familiarity with technology ecosystems, platform and infrastructure business models, distribution channels, go-to-market partnerships, or partner risk management.
Experience developing partner scorecards, governance frameworks, and executive business reviews.
Background working in a regulated or operationally complex environment.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.
Vanta is growing fast—we’re profitable, consistently exceeding our growth targets, and maintaining exceptionally strong NPS scores along the way. Our momentum is driven by a clear mission: to secure the internet and help startups scale with trust. As the category leader in compliance and security automation, we’re capturing market share rapidly, and our Sales team is at the forefront of that charge.
To support this continued growth, we’re expanding our Early Stage Sales team. We’re looking for high-energy, customer-focused French speaking Account Executive who thrive in high-volume, fast-paced environments and are motivated by the challenge of turning velocity into results.

In this role, you’ll take full ownership of the sales cycle—from first touch to close—and play a critical role in positioning Vanta as the go-to solution for early-stage companies navigating security and compliance for the first time.
This is a highly transactional, new business role where success comes from running a tight, repeatable process and maintaining a high daily output.
If you love the energy of working with startups, are driven to outperform targets, and want to make a tangible impact in a rapidly scaling business, we’d love to hear from you.
This role will be based in our Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.
What you’ll do as an Account Executive, Early Stage - EMEA at Vanta:
Identify high-potential business verticals to develop and execute outbound strategies to engage them with Vanta.
Manage the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to contract negotiation and closing, with a focus on speed and efficiency, aiming to close deals within a 30-day timeframe.
Turn our inbound demand into closed-won business quickly and consistently, working across a large number of prospects
Operate in a fast-paced, transactional sales environment, running a high number of discovery calls and managing a broad pipeline of opportunities simultaneously.
Continuously optimize your sales workflow to maintain high activity levels, improve conversion, and deliver repeatable results.
Define and communicate the value of Vanta to prospects, including tailoring sales materials and demos to resonate with early-stage startup buyers
Surface product feedback and trends from prospects to inform go-to-market and product development strategies.

s.h: How to be successful in this role
s.t:
Have 12+ months in a closing and quota-carrying role, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets
Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally focused on SMB or early-stage startups, where short deal cycles and high activity are the norm
Thrive in high-velocity sales environments and are energized by repetition, fast decision-making, and a transactional approach to deal flow
Be highly empathetic to customers, with a proven track record of long-term customer retention.
Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects.
Have stellar problem-solving chops, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up.
You’re intrinsically motivated, proactive, and resourceful—comfortable taking initiative without needing direction
Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact

About Vanta
We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation.

Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.
Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Agoda is a travel booking platform and accommodation is at our core. As our accommodation partners are a key to our success, we work hard to ensure their success. That is why the Strategic Accounts Management (SAM) team in Agoda specializes in account management.

Build repeatable, scalable processes and playbooks in an ambiguous environment, operating independently and shaping sales motions as you go.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
À propos du poste
En tant que responsable de compte Entreprise chez Anthropic, vous intégrerez l’équipe fondatrice en charge du déploiement de nos solutions API et SaaS de productivité, à la pointe de l’IA, à destination des organisations du secteur automobile en France.

Vous favoriserez l’adoption d’une IA sûre et de pointe en concluant des accords stratégiques avec des constructeurs automobiles, des équipementiers de rang 1 et de rang 2, ainsi que des fournisseurs de solutions de mobilité.

Vous mettrez à profit votre expertise en vente consultative dans le secteur automobile pour stimuler la croissance du chiffre d’affaires, tout en devenant un partenaire de confiance pour les parties prenantes du secteur automobile.

Vous les accompagnerez dans l’intégration et le déploiement de l’IA, en explorant tout son potentiel dans les domaines de l’ingénierie et de la conception, des opérations de fabrication, des services de véhicules connectés et de l’après-vente.

En collaboration avec les équipes GTM, Produit et Marketing, vous affinerez continuellement notre proposition de valeur, notre méthodologie de vente et notre positionnement sur le marché afin de répondre aux besoins des décideurs du secteur automobile.
Le candidat idéal est passionné par le développement de nouveaux segments de marché, par l'identification des opportunités à fort potentiel et mettre en œuvre des stratégies pour les saisir. En favorisant le déploiement des produits émergents d'Anthropic, vous aiderez les entreprises à acquérir de nouvelles capacités tout en favorisant le développement éthique de l'IA.

Développez le portefeuille clients et stimulez les revenus d’Anthropic dans le secteur automobile. Naviguez au sein d’organisations complexes du secteur automobile pour identifier les décideurs clés, les informer sur nos services et les accompagner vers le succès avec Anthropic. Vous serez responsable de l’ensemble du cycle de vente, depuis le premier contact jusqu’à la conclusion.
Concevoir et exécuter des stratégies de vente innovantes adaptées aux cycles d'approvisionnement automobiles, à la qualification des fournisseurs et aux processus budgétaires afin d'atteindre et de dépasser les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires. Analyser les paysages, les tendances et la dynamique du marché automobile pour transformer les plans stratégiques en activités et campagnes de vente ciblées

How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Location: Paris
About the Department
Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences.
The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.

Our Southern Europe Sales Team has been building an Enterprise focussed team spanning across mid-tier and all the way up to Global 2000 Enterprise accounts. Cloudflare has accelerated bringing both Enterprise and Fortune 1000 companies onto our platform in recent years, and this team will do that with more focus, faster pace, and higher long term growth expectations.
As the Sales Manager you will lead our France Mid Market Sales Team. Team Leadership: Direct leadership of Mid-Market Account Executives (AEs), while aligning cross-functional support roles (BDRs, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Field Marketing).

Process & Methodology: Implement and drive best practices using the company’s sales methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) across pipeline management, forecasting, and account expansion.

Deal Support: Act as an operational point of contact and dynamic "player-coach" to help close strategic mid-market deals and resolve operational roadblocks.
Governance: Ensure corporate policy and sales standards are consistently followed by the team.
Cadence & Rigor: Maintain a structured operational cadence: weekly forecast calls, pipeline reviews, 1-on-1 coaching sessions, deal reviews, and team meetings.

Experience: 5+ years of sales management experience in B2B SaaS/Tech, preceded by a strong track record as an individual contributor selling into mid-sized businesses.

Technical Aptitude: Experience or strong familiarity with cloud security, network performance, Zero Trust, SASE, and modern web architecture.
Sales Rigor: Mastery of sales methodologies, CRM hygiene (Salesforce), pipeline generation strategies, and accurate quarterly forecasting.
Leadership Style: Hands-on leader capable of coaching, developing early-to-mid career AEs, and driving high team energy and performance.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Renewals are the heartbeat of Samsara’s long-term success. As a Renewals Account Executive for our Canadian Mid-Market segment, you will lead the commercial strategy for a portfolio of 50–75 high-value accounts per quarter. This is a high-impact role where you will be responsible for securing favourable renewal terms while minimizing financial attrition, identifying growth opportunities, passing findings and insights back to the business, and closing 36-month renewal deals.
Your mission is to balance efficiency with high-touch strategic negotiation, ensuring our Canadian customers continue to see Samsara as their "source of truth" and long term partner for physical operations.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work, whether you’re diving into the inner workings of a food distribution center or a waste management firm to understand how our technology makes them better.
You thrive in a competitive arena and play to win: You aren't intimidated by a "save" cycle; you lean into it. You are a creative thinker who can confidently advocate for a customer’s resources at time of renewal and prove why Samsara remains their best-in-class partner. You expect to win because you believe in our value, and you have the grit to defend our footprint against any competitor.
You are a Master of Prioritization : You know how to triage a book of business, while dedicating deep strategic work to your six-figure "anchor" accounts. You take pride in a clean forecast, and know that deal execution is an essential part of hitting your numbers.
You are a Value Architect who builds genuine relationships: You don’t just "process" a contract; you re-confirm the business case. You build trust quickly, and you can articulate ROI to a CFO or operational value to a Fleet Manager with equal fluency.
You can navigate internal complexity to win as a team : You recognize that sales is a team sport. You are comfortable collaborating with Deal Desk, Legal, and Finance to navigate custom terms and "get to yes" on agreements, all while sharing best practices to help the broader team succeed.
You want to be with the best: You thrive in a high-performance culture where you are surrounded by top-tier talent. You are looking for a role that challenges you to go farther than you have before, moving with urgency and a growth mindset to secure the revenue that fuels Samsara’s mission.

Own the Canadian Mid-Market: Act as the primary commercial lead for a portfolio of 50–75 renewals per quarter. You will manage high-touch accounts ranging from $25k to $300k+ , serving as a dedicated expert on the Canadian business landscape, local competitors, and regional market trends.
Drive Full-Cycle Commercial Execution: Lead every stage of the renewal process, from initial quoting and complex negotiations to securing internal approvals. You will prioritize 36-month terms to stabilize the partnership and maximize long-term Lifetime Value (LTV).
Forecast with Precision: Maintain impeccable Salesforce hygiene to ensure your pipeline is a "single source of truth." You will provide leadership with scenario forecasting, clear visibility into territory risks, and data-driven insights that make your outcomes predictable.
Strategize Across the Account Team: Partner seamlessly with CSMs and AEs to map out expansion opportunities. You will bridge the gap between retention and growth, identifying expansion opportunities while ensuring a frictionless, unified experience for the customer.
Operate as a Business Owner: Take full accountability for your territory’s health. You don't just manage a list; you proactively solve for churn, advocate for the needs of the Canadian market, and lean into the "owner" mindset to hit and exceed your retention targets.

Experience: 2+ years of full-cycle closing or strategic renewals experience, specifically managing Mid-Market or Commercial accounts.
Commercial acumen: Proven track record of managing $1M+ in quarterly quota with deal sizes above $100k
Canadian Market Context: Experience navigating the Canadian business landscape (familiarity with regional industries like transport, construction, or field services is a plus).
Negotiation Prowess: Ability to manage multi-stakeholder "save" cycles and handle complex procurement/legal requirements.
Operational Excellence: Expert proficiency in Salesforce and a disciplined approach to pipeline management.

Lead efforts to grow Toast market share in the multi-unit restaurant industry through establishment and cultivation of ongoing relationships at the C-Suite level through research, cold-calling and networking to develop a qualified pipeline of prospects.
Create demand by educating prospects on the Toast value proposition of products and solutions through demonstrations and presentations communicating a compelling purchase rationale.

Own your own leverage. Continuously identify the repetitive parts of the role — research, prep, notes, follow-up, list building and systematically get them off your plate, so the majority of your week is spent in live conversation with operators.
Work evidence, not alphabetical order. Prioritise accounts based on observable change in the operator's business: expansion, ownership change, hiring patterns, guest feedback trends, visible technology, and disqualify unworkable accounts quickly so your capacity concentrates where it can actually close.
Treat your book as an asset you maintain. Keep account and contact records accurate, current, and deduplicated, understanding that routing, scoring, and every AI-assisted workflow is only as good as the data underneath it.
Untangle who really decides. Resolve complex ownership structures, franchise groups, multiple legal entities, operators running several concepts under different names to identify and reach the actual economic decision maker rather than whoever answers the phone.
Arrive already informed, and earn trust in a low-trust market. Focus on the operator's specific situation rather than a product pitch, and recognise that many operators have been burned by a previous vendor; credibility, not feature comparisons, is often what wins the deal.
Close the loop on what's broken. Flag bad data, wrong contacts, and signals that didn't hold up, so the system your whole team relies on improves rather than quietly eroding.

Prioritize accounts based on observable change in the operator's business: expansion, ownership change, hiring patterns, guest feedback trends, visible technology, and disqualify unworkable accounts quickly so your capacity concentrates where it can actually close.
Treat your book as an asset you maintain. Keep account and contact records accurate, current, and deduplicated, understanding that routing, scoring, and every AI-assisted workflow is only as good as the data underneath it.
Untangle who really decides. Resolve complex ownership structures, franchise groups, multiple legal entities, operators running several concepts under different names to identify and reach the actual economic decision maker rather than whoever answers the phone.
Arrive already informed, and earn trust in a low-trust market. Focus on the operator's specific situation rather than a product pitch, and recognize that many operators have been burned by a previous vendor; credibility, not feature comparisons, is often what wins the deal.
Close the loop on what's broken. Flag bad data, wrong contacts, and signals that didn't hold up, so the system your whole team relies on improves rather than quietly eroding.

After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. The Toast Retail platform is already winning with independent operators. Now we are moving
upmarket.This role is the person who helps build the commercial motion as we shift towards increasingly complex upmarket accounts.

As Manager of Mid-Market Sales for Toast Retail, you will lead a small team of Mid-Market Account Executives pursuing multi-location retail with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. These are complex accounts with real buying committees, layered compliance requirements, deep inventory and SKU demands, and incumbent systems that took years to entrench. Winning them requires a sales motion that does not exist at Toast Retail yet. You will build it.
This is not a role for someone looking to inherit a playbook and run it well. There is no Mid-Market Toast Retail playbook. A growing set of proof points from our SMB business, a leadership team that is investing, and a set of open questions that someone has to go answer.

What does discovery look like when the buyer is a VP of Operations and not an owner? Which of our SMB motions translate upmarket and which have to be rebuilt? What do we need from Product to be credible in a 40 store grocery chain?

You will form the hypotheses, run them in the field, and turn what works into something repeatable that the next ten AEs can execute.
Expect to spend real time outside your own team.

Getting this motion off the ground means sitting with Product on inventory and scan data gaps, with Marketing on messaging that lands with a category buyer, with Enablement on training that does not exist yet, with Deal Desk and Finance on structures we have not offered before, and with Onboarding on implementations that are meaningfully harder than a single site install.

Your ability to move those partners without formal authority over any of them will matter as much as your ability to coach a deal.
This is a player coach role in year one. You will carry a number yourself while you hire and build the team, which means you will be closing Mid-Market Retail deals before you are coaching them. That is deliberate. The person who writes this playbook should draw from their own first-hand experiences from running the motion, not just observations of other people running it. As the team scales, your quota shifts to theirs.
You will report to the VP of Sales, Toast Retail. This is a remote opportunity with travel expectations up to 40 percent of the time.

Carry and deliver an individual quota in year one (player-coach) while you hire, onboard, and ramp your team, transitioning to a full team number as your team scales.
Hire, develop, motivate, and manage a quota achieving Mid-Market sales team from the ground up, setting the bar for talent in a brand new function
Build and codify the Mid-Market Retail sales process: discovery frameworks, demo flows, business case models, mutual action plans, and executive proposals tailored to grocery, liquor, and convenience buyers
Run a disciplined sales process and coach your team on qualification rigor, multithreading, and champion development inside complex retail organizations
Own live Mid-Market deals end to end yourself, then convert what you learn into discovery frameworks, demo flows, business cases, and proposals the team can run
Get in the field. Join discovery calls, sit in on site visits, and walk stores with your reps so the playbook you write is grounded in what actually happens in front of a customer
Own all stages of the sales lifecycle with your team: pipeline generation, executive meetings, value proposition development, deal structuring, negotiation, and close
Partner across Product, Marketing, Enablement, Deal Desk, Finance, and Onboarding to close the gaps that stand between us and a repeatable Mid-Market motion, and escalate the ones you cannot close yourself
Bring the voice of the Mid-Market retailer back into the product roadmap with specificity and evidence, not anecdotes
Forecast accurately in a business with little historical data, and be honest about what you know versus what you are still learning
Assess and engage in competitive RFPs
Leverage GTM tech stack to run an efficient, AI-anchored motion: establish the conversion benchmarks that do not exist yet, and report on them credibly.
Distinguish repeatable process from one off hero deals, and build only the former into the playbook
Stay close to the competitive landscape across grocery, liquor, and convenience technology, and position Toast Retail sharply against incumbents

About Cytix
Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.
That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.
We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.
Make the first move . When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.
Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.
See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.
Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.
Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

s.h: THIS IS A REAL STEP INTO CLOSING
s.t:
You booked the meeting. Someone else closed it. Not here.
Your number. Your accounts. Your calls. Your deals. Start to finish.
You already know this feeling
You worked the account for weeks. You found the pain, you got the right person on the phone, you booked the meeting. Then you handed it over and watched someone else take it to signature and pick up the commission.
This is the seat where you keep it.

You own a UK and Ireland mid-market patch and carry a monthly new-business ARR target. You find every opportunity yourself, and you close it yourself. There is no SDR underneath you and nobody filling your diary. We give you the data, the tools, the coaching and a few live opportunities to get you moving. Everything after that is yours to build.
If that reads as a warning, this is not your role. If it reads as an opportunity, keep going.
What you’ll actually be doing
Picking your target accounts and going after them properly
Cold calling. Every week. It does not stop being part of the job when you start closing
Running discovery that reaches business impact, not a feature checklist
Demoing Joblogic to operations directors, finance and business owners
Multi-threading, building the commercial case, negotiating and closing
Keeping HubSpot honest and forecasting a number you are happy to be held to
What we’ll give you
A structured 90-day ramp into discovery, demonstrations, commercials and closing. You will never be guessing what good looks like
Full coaching as standard: MEDDPICC is our qualification standard and we will teach it to you, alongside discovery, demo and negotiation training, weekly call reviews and deal clinics
Live opportunities at the start to get you selling while you build your own engine
The data, tooling and tech stack to prospect properly, so your time goes on selling rather than list building
A real career, with a fast-growing, PE-backed software business scaling to £100M ARR. This is the first seat of a career here, not the last
You’ll love this if
You have 12-36 months as an SDR or BDR and you have smashed your number, and you can prove it with real figures
A cold call that turns into a deal is still the best part of your week
You are competitive with yourself before you are competitive with anyone else
You want feedback, not comfort, and you act on it fast
You want to be judged on ARR, not on dials and diary entries
You are curious about how businesses actually make money, not just about hitting activity targets

You want your pipeline handed to you.
You think prospecting stops the day you start closing.
Your best answer to “how did you perform?” is “the team hit target”.
Joblogic in thirty seconds
We are the UK’s #1 Field Service Management software platform. Founded in 1998, ~£35M ARR, 500+ people and over 100,000 users across HVAC, plumbing, electrical maintenance, facilities management and building fabric maintenance. We are backed by Vista Equity Partners with over £100 million of new capital behind us, and we are scaling to £100M ARR with an AI-first product roadmap.
Put simply: the market is huge, the product wins, and the ceiling on this team has just been lifted. We need people who want to run at that.

Send us your CV, and tell us in a few lines about the best opportunity you have ever self-sourced (In the Cover Letter). How you found it, how you got in, what happened next. We are far more interested in that than in how your CV is formatted.
Bring energy. This team runs on it.
