What to expect

Understanding the Company and Product : Gain a deep understanding of the company's products or services, value proposition, and the competitive landscape. This includes completing all necessary onboarding training and familiarizing oneself with the company culture and processes.
Relationship Building : Begin to establish relationships with key internal stakeholders, including sales, marketing, product, and customer support teams. Understanding their roles and how they can contribute to the success of strategic accounts is crucial.
Client Familiarization: Start to get acquainted with the portfolio of strategic accounts, including reviewing account histories, previous interactions, and current contracts or agreements. Initial meetings with some key clients may also take place to introduce yourself as their new point of contact.

Strategic Planning: Develop detailed strategic plans for each key account, identifying opportunities for growth, potential challenges, and strategic objectives. This should be done in collaboration with clients and internal teams.
Performance Metrics: Establish clear KPIs for success within your accounts, aligned with both client expectations and company goals. Begin tracking these metrics closely.
Sales and Negotiations: Start actively pursuing new business opportunities within strategic accounts, which may involve negotiating terms for contracts or renewals. Efforts to cross-sell or up-sell should also be underway.
Feedback Loop: Implement a process for regularly gathering and acting on client feedback to improve service delivery and client satisfaction.

Achieving Sales Targets: By the one-year mark, you should have met or exceeded the initial sales targets set for your strategic accounts. This includes successfully closing new deals and expanding business within existing accounts.
Strategic Account Growth: Demonstrated growth in strategic accounts through increased engagement, higher revenue, and enhanced partnership levels. Your strategic planning and execution should result in tangible benefits for both the clients and your company.
Relationship Depth: At this point, you should have established deep, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders within each strategic account. You're seen as a strategic advisor rather than just a sales contact.
Process Improvements: Identification and implementation of process improvements based on lessons learned over the year to increase efficiency, customer satisfaction, and sales effectiveness.
Professional Development : Continued professional growth, possibly including leadership development, advanced sales strategies, and industry knowledge enhancement to better serve strategic accounts and contribute to the company's objectives.
Success in an Account Executive Strategic role is measured not just by sales figures but by the depth of relationships built, the strategic value delivered to clients, and the positive impact on the company’s long-term growth. Regular reviews against these expectations can help in identifying areas for improvement and adjusting strategies as necessary.

We are seeking an experienced Sales Manager to build and scale our business with Chinese customers across our full range of logistics services—including Ocean, Air Freight, Customs, Trucking, and Warehousing—identifying high-potential clients and closing deals. Developing new Chinese customers and driving customer acquisition across Ocean, Air Freight, Customs, Trucking, and Warehousing services, keeping Flexport's offering competitive and innovative.
Researching territories and verticals to identify and build relationships with new potential Chinese customers.
Building and growing Flexport's business across all product lines by closing net-new business.
Uncovering and connecting with ideal clients through a combination of self-prospecting and collaboration with our Sales Development Representative (SDR) team.
Consulting with new clients to comprehensively understand their logistics and supply chain needs.
Creating value-added solutions and demonstrating our capabilities through remote and in-person meetings.
Leading the customer onboarding process by effectively leveraging internal resources and teams to ensure a smooth transition.
Managing an assigned portfolio while prioritizing new business development, closing deals across the Sales Channel (Ocean, Air Freight, Customs, Trucking, and Warehousing)
Developing a strong understanding of all service offerings to deliver integrated logistics solutions to customers.
Staying aligned with strategic direction and market signals to capture both short-term and long-term business opportunities.
Communicating key market trends, pricing shifts, and policy changes to the assigned portfolio.
Partnering closely with Customer Service, Commercial Planning, Product, and other teams to keep customer needs and market insights current, and coordinating a commercial response to customer and market conditions.

5+ years of shipping/logistics experience, including 2–3 years in quota-carrying sales and specifically in the Asian market.
Solid knowledge of ocean freight, air freight, customs , trucking , cross-border trucking and general logistics services.

Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar
Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina . Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven , creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.
Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal , reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones .
Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.
Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.
Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, ingresa a: grupoquintoandar.com/es/
Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo
Nuestro equipo de Key Account Manager trabaja bajo el modelo “híbrido”, siendo necesario estar presencialmente en la oficina, ubicada en Buenos Aires, 2 veces por semana.
Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío
El Hunter de Expansión es un perfil netamente estratégico y de apertura de mercado. Su misión principal es desembarcar y consolidar la presencia de la compañía en nuevas zonas geográficas, nuevas plazas o verticales de negocio no exploradas (como abrir nuevas zonas en GBA o penetrar el modelo híbrido en el interior). No maneja cartera existente; su foco es el crecimiento desde cero,
Tus Responsabilidades
Apertura de Nuevas Plazas: Liderar la estrategia de entrada comercial en nuevas geografías, mapeando competidores locales y detectando barreras de entrada.
Captación Agresiva (Paid Publisher): Introducir los modelos de monetización y planes premium de la compañía en el nuevo mercado, logrando los primeros cierres clave.
Generación de Demanda Local: Desarrollar relaciones sólidas desde cero con los principales actores del mercado objetivo (inmobiliarias locales, desarrolladores)
Alianza con Operaciones: Trabajar de la mano con los equipos de producto y marketing para adaptar el discurso comercial a las particularidades culturales y económicas de la nueva plaza.
Growth Comercial: Asegurar que la nueva plaza alcance la masa crítica de listing o facturación necesaria en los plazos estipulados por el Business Plan (BP).
Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)
Experiencia: Mínimo 3 a 5 años en roles de desarrollo de negocio ( Business Development ), ventas corporativas de campo (territoriales) o expansión en empresas de tecnología/proptech.
Habilidades Blandas: Autonomía extrema, pensamiento estratégico, visión de negocio, adaptabilidad al cambio y habilidades de comunicación a nivel ejecutivo.

Diseñamos un proceso transparente, directo y enfocado en evaluar tu potencial técnico y comportamental, dándote la oportunidad de conocer a nuestros equipos y rutas de carrera:

About Semarchy Semarchy helps enterprises master, govern, and put their data to work through a unified Data Platform spanning Master Data Management, data quality, and data governance, deployable natively inside Snowflake or as SaaS. The RoleWe're hiring an Account Executive for our AMER Enterprise team. You'll own a full-cycle book of business, from qualifying inbound and self-sourced pipeline through discovery, solution development, demo, negotiation, and close. Our deals are consultative and multi-stakeholder: you're rarely selling to one person, and the technical conversation is usually a proxy for a business one underneath it.
Ownership doesn't end at signature. You'll build the account plan, hand off cleanly to Professional Services and Customer Success, and come back in to lead the commercial conversation when it's time to expand, renew, or move an existing customer onto our newly upgraded platform. Responsibilities

Build pipeline. Generate and qualify opportunities through inbound requests, closed-lost revisits, referrals, and your own outbound. Keep Salesforce and Gong current as deals move, not just at quarter-end, so your forecast holds up two months out.
Run discovery that gets past the ticket. Uncover the prospect's high-level company goals, bring company and industry context into the call, and get past the technical and personal pain to the real organizational stakes: what happens if nothing changes, and why that matters to the business.
Multi-thread the deal. Identify who else needs to be in the room and bring them in deliberately, rather than waiting for the prospect to volunteer them.
Shape the solution. Understand what the prospect thinks they need, and know when to introduce a requirement they haven't asked for yet, whether that's a related module or the specific reason we're the better fit against the alternative they're evaluating.
Partner with your SC on a demo that sells the pain, not the feature. Own the value narrative and coordinate the technical demo with your Solutions Consultant, who leads it. Tie what's shown back to what the prospect named in discovery, and give your SC the lead time they need to prep, especially when a demo gets booked with less than a day's notice.
Negotiate a real plan. Know which agreement you need next given where the deal actually is, and leave every call with a specific next step, a date, and a named owner on both sides.
Build a business case your champion can carry into their own organization, tied to the financial and operational impact you uncovered together.
Manage the process to close, tracking the paper, security review, and approvals that sit between a verbal yes and a signature.
Own the account plan and the handoff. Build the plan for your named accounts, lead a clean handoff to Professional Services and Customer Success at close, and stay the commercial owner for expansion, renewal, and platform-transition conversations in your book.

A track record closing complex, multi-stakeholder software deals, ideally in data, analytics, or platform categories.
Comfort running a structured sales process while staying present and conversational. The framework should make the conversation feel more natural, not scripted.
Directness balanced with warmth. You can name a stalled buy-in or an unrealistic timeline out loud, in a way that keeps the relationship intact.
Genuine curiosity about the prospect's business, not just their tech stack. You ask a second and third “why,” and you're comfortable letting a call go somewhere your outline didn't predict.
Coachability. You take feedback, apply it, and can name your own gaps before someone else does.
A collaborative style, especially with your SC. You don't need deep technical fluency on day one; you need the instinct to loop your SC in early and work the deal together, not around them. You also bring in deal desk, partners, and leadership early.
Ownership. You flag a deal risk before it becomes a surprise, and you show up with a plan alongside it.
Judgment about where your time goes. With a growing book, you know which two or three accounts genuinely need you this week and protect the rest of your time for the next deal.

Experience selling into Snowflake or Databricks ecosystems.
Familiarity with MDM, data governance, or data quality, or the track record to get there fast.
Experience competing against vendors like Informatica or Reltio.

After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. The Toast Retail platform is already winning with independent operators. Now we are moving upmarket, and this is one of the key sales roles that proves the commercial motion as we pursue increasingly complex retail accounts.

As a founding Mid Market Account Executive for Toast Retail, you will source and close multi-location retail deals with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. These are complex accounts with real buying committees, layered compliance requirements, deep inventory and SKU demands, and incumbent systems that took years to entrench. Winning them requires a sales motion that does not fully exist at Toast Retail yet. You will help build it, one deal at a time.
This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a finished playbook. Some proof points exist from our SMB business, leadership is investing, and there is a set of open questions that closers in the field have to go answer. What does discovery look like when the buyer is a VP of Operations and not an owner?

Which SMB motions translate upmarket and which have to be rebuilt? What do we need from Product to be credible in a 40 store grocery chain? You will form hypotheses, test them in live deals, and feed what works back so the next AEs can run it.
You will report to the Manager, Mid Market Sales, Toast Retail. This is a remote opportunity with travel expectations of 30% or more, including store walks and on site visits.

Pipeline and prospecting: Build a qualified pipeline of multi-location grocery, liquor, and convenience operators through category research, cold calling, networking, and close partnership with our SMB Retail teams to identify accounts ready to move upmarket.
Retail centric discovery: Run disciplined discovery against buying committees rather than single owners. Learn the operational realities that move a category buyer, from inventory depth and scan data to shrink, margin, and compliance, and turn them into a compelling case for Toast Retail.
Value based selling: Create demand by educating prospects on the Toast Retail value proposition through demonstrations and tailored business cases. Sell on platform value and outcomes over price, and help operators understand which products actually fit their scale.
Full lifecycle ownership: Own the entire journey, from lead development and financial structuring to contract negotiation and close. Collaborate with Account Service and Implementation to ensure a seamless handoff on retail installs that are meaningfully harder than a single site.
Complex deal navigation: Manage lengthy sales cycles with real ambiguity. Multithread across operations, finance, IT, and merchandising, and develop champions inside layered retail organizations.
Internal collaboration: Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Biz Ops, and Finance to structure deals, and hold your ground in negotiations so terms align with Toast's goals. Work with Product, Marketing, and Enablement to close the gaps between us and a repeatable Mid Market Retail motion, and escalate the ones you cannot close yourself.
Build as you close: Convert what works in your live deals into discovery notes, demo flows, and business case models the next AEs can run. Distinguish a repeatable process from a one off hero deal, and help codify the former.
Voice of the retailer: Bring the Mid Market retailer's needs back into the product roadmap with specificity and evidence, not anecdotes.
Revenue mindset: Optimize for long term realized revenue, not just bookings. Evaluate the full financial impact of every deal, ask what it will actually cost us, and make thoughtful trade offs on pricing, discounts, and terms while protecting Toast's bottom line.
Operational excellence: Maintain high standards of execution, prioritization, and follow through in Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack, and help establish the conversion benchmarks that do not exist yet.

5+ years of successful technology or professional services sales experience, ideally within SaaS, payments, or retail or restaurant industry technology.

Proven skills in complex deal development, financial structuring, negotiation, and closing with both new and existing customers, with a focus on selling on value rather than deep discounting.

A builder's instinct. You are energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity, and when a process is missing your instinct is to write it rather than wait for it.

Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.
Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across 200+ specialties and +12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power.

In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around. In time, this will drive quality up and prices down.
We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.

Zocdoc’s goal is to become the scheduling layer for healthcare, making it easier for patients to find and access the care they need. At the heart of that goal are our integrations. They connect Zocdoc to the systems our customers use every day and make it possible for patients to see accurate availability and book care. For our Enterprise customers, integrations are not just a technical requirement. They are a core part of why customers choose Zocdoc and how they get value from the platform.
As an Enterprise Sales Manager, Integrations, you’ll lead the Technical Implementation Specialist team responsible for bringing those integrations to life for our largest and most complex customers. Your team owns the technical implementation experience from discovery through launch, making sure integrations are designed correctly, move with urgency, and support the customer’s goals.
You will hire, train, develop, and retain top talent while continuing to raise both the technical and commercial capabilities of the team. You will coach your team to build trust quickly, navigate complex customer environments, clearly communicate technical requirements, and keep implementations moving forward.
You will create a culture of accountability, urgency, and ownership, with a strong focus on hitting targets around implementation speed, quality, customer adoption, and provider growth. You will be responsible not just for the results of the team, but for building a team that continues to get better over time and consistently delivers a high-quality implementation experience for our customers.

Resilient and resourceful. You lead calmly through ambiguity and make high-quality decisions even when information is incomplete.
Collaborative and relationship-driven. You know how to align diverse internal stakeholders toward shared goals, especially across sales, product, implementation, engineering, and integration teams.

Le sens de la conviction : Tu n'hésites pas à donner ton avis, même face à une figure d'autorité. Tu préfères une discussion franche au consensus facile.
Une résilience sans faille : L'échec te pousse à redoubler d'efforts. Un "non" n'est jamais une fin en soi, mais le point de départ pour trouver une autre solution.
Le goût de l'accomplissement : Tu as besoin de te fixer des défis pour avancer. Tu aimes la compétition et tu cherches un environnement où tes efforts sont récompensés à leur juste valeur.
Une curiosité naturelle : Tu aimes creuser un sujet pour en comprendre les racines. Tu poses les bonnes questions pour comprendre un problème avant d'agir.
Le sens de l'autonomie : Tu apprécies la liberté d'organiser tes journées et tu sais faire preuve d'une grande rigueur personnelle pour atteindre tes objectifs.

0 à 3 ans d'expérience après la fin de tes études.

Français parfait et niveau avancé en anglais (C1\).

THE JOB Warum mute-labs? Bei mute-labs gibt es weder „VC-getriebenen Burnout“ noch toxische Sales Floors. Wir sind ein eigenfinanziertes, nachhaltig profitables Team mit einer klaren Mission: mehr Ruhe in die lautesten Büros der Welt zu bringen.
Wir entwickeln und produzieren hochwertige Akustikboxen, die wirklich zu modernen Arbeitswelten passen.
Dabei verkaufen wir nicht einfach nur „Boxen“ – wir verkaufen Fokus, Produktivität und ein besseres Arbeitsumfeld.
Für den DACH-Markt suchen wir einen Full-Cycle BDR , der den gesamten Sales-Prozess selbst in die Hand nehmen möchte – vom ersten „Hallo“ bis zum finalen Handshake.
Die Rolle: Beratung statt einfach nur telefonieren Bei uns liest Du kein vorgefertigtes Skript ab. Du berätst Unternehmen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz dabei, bessere Arbeitswelten zu gestalten.
Qualifizierte Inbound Leads: Vergiss wahlloses „Smile and Dial“. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für hochwertige Leads – Unternehmen, die bereits echtes Interesse an unseren Produkten haben.
Pipeline-Aufbau: Du identifizierst relevante Entscheider:innen wie Facility Manager, HR Leads oder Founder und baust eine Pipeline auf, bei der Qualität wichtiger ist als reine Quantität.
End-to-End Ownership: Du identifizierst potenzielle Kund:innen, führst Discovery Calls und Demos durch und schließt Deine Deals selbst ab. So siehst Du am Ende ganz konkret, wie Deine Arbeit in Form einer mute-labs Box im Büro des Kunden steht.
Kein Ellenbogen-Sales: Bei uns gibt es keine Provision. Warum? Weil wir möchten, dass Du das tust, was für den Kunden und das Team am besten ist – nicht das, was Deinen Bonus maximiert. Stattdessen bieten wir ein wettbewerbsfähiges, stabiles Fixgehalt, weil wir auf Deine intrinsische Motivation setzen.
So könnte Dein Tag bei uns aussehen Wir leben eine Office-First-Kultur . Wir glauben, dass die besten Sales-Ideen bei einem gemeinsamen Kaffee entstehen – und nicht in endlosen Slack-Threads.
09:00 | Morning Vibe: Du kommst in unser energiegeladenes Office in Berlin-Mitte, holst Dir einen Kaffee, checkst die neuesten Leads und planst Deinen Tag.
09:30 | Action Phase: Du bist am Telefon oder im Video-Call, sprichst mit neuen Leads über ihre Office-Herausforderungen und vereinbarst Demos.
11:00 | Strategy Huddle: Kurzer Austausch mit Alvaro, unserem Country Manager, oder Jarno, unserem Sales Director, zu einem konkreten Deal oder einem Markttrend, den Du entdeckt hast.
12:30 | Family Table: Wir essen gemeinsam. Freitags kocht ein Team für die ganze Firma. Ob Pasta, Tacos oder ein persönlicher Klassiker – beim gemeinsamen Mittagessen kommen wir als Team zusammen.
14:30 | Market Mastery: Du führst Discovery Demos. Dabei hörst Du mehr zu, als Du redest, und findest heraus, wo beim Kunden wirklich der Schuh drückt.
18:00 | The Close: Du bringst Dein CRM auf den neuesten Stand, aktualisierst Deine Pipeline und machst Feierabend. Deine Offline-Zeit respektieren wir.
Pulse & Pints Friday Jeden Freitag lassen wir die Woche gemeinsam ausklingen.
The Pulse: In unserem Team-Huddle schauen wir auf die Zahlen, teilen Company Updates und feiern Kolleg:innen, die in dieser Woche besonders viel bewegt haben.
The Pints: Danach starten wir gemeinsam ins Wochenende – mit Drinks, alkoholisch oder 0,0 %, und dem guten Gefühl, gemeinsam etwas erreicht zu haben.
Unser Bewerbungsprozess: Schnell & transparent Wir wissen, dass gute Kandidat:innen gefragt sind – deshalb lassen wir Dich nicht wochenlang warten.
The Spark: Ein kurzer Screening Call mit Lia , um herauszufinden, ob unsere Werte und Vorstellungen zusammenpassen.
The Market Fit: Ein Deep Dive mit Alvaro (Country Manager) und Jarno (Sales Director), bei dem es um Deine Sales-DNA geht.
The Commercial View: Ein Gespräch mit Leah (Head of Commercial) über unsere Wachstumsstrategie und Deine Rolle darin.
The Live Action: Ein Discovery Role Play mit dem Team. Keine Hausaufgabe, keine tagelange Vorbereitung – wir möchten einfach sehen, wie Du ein echtes Kundengespräch führst.
The Vision: Ein finales Gespräch mit unserem CEO , in dem es um das große Ganze und Deine Entwicklung bei mute-labs geht.
Erkennst Du Dich wieder? Self-Driven Hunter: Du brauchst keinen Provisionscheck, um ambitioniert zu bleiben. Du willst Deine Ziele erreichen und das Unternehmen aktiv mit voranbringen.
Native Communicator: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kannst Dich sicher und überzeugend im DACH-Markt bewegen.
Full-Cycle Mindset: Du magst sowohl den Reiz, neue Leads zu finden, als auch das gute Gefühl, einen Deal selbst zum Abschluss zu bringen.
Team Player: Arbeiten in Silos ist nichts für Dich. Du möchtest Erfolge teilen, voneinander lernen und Deine Kolleg:innen genauso bei ihren Deals unterstützen wie bei Deinen eigenen.
Bereit, mehr Ruhe in die Arbeitswelt zu bringen? Wenn Du nach einer Sales-Rolle suchst, in der Du als Profi behandelt wirst, von einem starken Team unterstützt wirst und in einer offenen, ambitionierten Office-Kultur arbeiten möchtest, dann wollen wir Dich kennenlernen.
Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir melden uns schneller bei Dir, als Du denkst!
ABOUT US Here at mute-labs, we aim to enable companies to achieve more by democratizing silence in the workspace. And we’re not like any other Berlin startup you might know:
We’re “no tech” : We know how to develop and sell great hardware products with a focus on sound-insulated phone- and meeting booths .
We have no investors and we really don’t want any. We've been profitable since day one.
We continue to have a steep growth curve – not in employees or coffee cups consumed, but in revenue and profit.
We’re not striving for an exit – we’re building a sustainable business for many generations to come.
Wondering what it's like to work here? We made a reel about it!
Are you as excited about mute-labs as we are? Then we are looking forward to getting to know you!

Last time we hired an Account Executive, we received a total of 120 applications but only 15 were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:
CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light.

What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on.

A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Elastic, the Search AI company, is looking for a high-energy, mission-driven Public Sector Account Executive to drive net-new revenue and expansion within government accounts centered in Brasília, Brazil .
In this role, you will be the primary owner of a strategic federal and public sector territory. You will build your own pipeline, communicate the Elastic Search AI value proposition to government stakeholders, and navigate complex procurement and deal cycles—spanning both net-new logos and our installed base—within a consumption-based cloud model.

Sitting at the intersection of sales execution, technical fluency, and public sector domain strategy, this position is critical to accelerating Elastic’s growth across government entities in Brazil.

Own Your Territory & Build Pipeline: Develop and execute a proactive outbound strategy across public sector entities in Brasília, leveraging community, customer, and partner ecosystems to generate $\ge 50\%$ of your booked opportunities.
Deep Discovery & Qualification: Uncover mission pains, business impact, public budgets, and decision criteria using disciplined frameworks like MEDDPICC to manage high-confidence pipeline.
Value Storytelling & Demos: Deliver tailored narratives and demonstrations that map Elastic’s Search AI, Observability, and Security capabilities to core government priorities, digital transformation, and citizen services.
Mutual Deal Strategy & Forecast Accuracy: Collaborate with public sector stakeholders to construct formal close plans, managing sales cycles and drive predictable sales execution by maintaining 90%+ forecast accuracy within +/- 10%.
Executive Negotiation & Closing: Guide complex public sector procurement processes, structuring give/get trades and securing multi-year consumption and project commitments.
Complex Project Execution: Drive high-value, complex projects into net-new government logos while expanding Elastic usage across our current public sector installed base.
Domain & Cloud Acumen: Position Elastic as the Search AI platform of choice by speaking fluently about cloud economics, usage-based pricing, and modern enterprise data architectures.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and strategic Channel Partners (distributors/integrators) to accelerate deals and deliver measurable customer outcomes.

Proven Public Sector SaaS Success: 5+ years of experience closing complex Enterprise/Public Sector deals, consistently overachieving quotas within SaaS, cloud, or consumption-based environments.
Installed Base & Net-New Growth: Demonstrated track record of selling complex projects into net-new government logos as well as expanding within existing accounts.
Public Sector Acumen in Brasília: Deep familiarity navigating government procurement processes, budget cycles, RFIs/RFPs, and decision-making dynamics within Brazilian public sector entities.
Ecosystem & Technical Fluency: Solid understanding of enterprise software ecosystems, including Enterprise Search, Logging, Security (SIEM/XDR), Observability (APM/metrics), Vector/AI Search, and Cloud platforms.
Expert Qualification & MEDDPICC Skills: Mastery in applying MEDDPICC or equivalent frameworks to navigate multi-stakeholder public sector deal cycles.
Executive & Developer Credibility: Ability to build strong relationships across technical teams, developers, and executive/governmental decision-makers.
Open Source Model Appreciation: Genuine appreciation for the Open Source go-to-market model and the developer/user community that relies on Elastic solutions daily.
Fluency: Native/Fluent Portuguese with professional proficiency in English.
Must be located in Brasilia, Brazil

Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.
We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
Our vision is to transform presentations, meetings and lectures by turning passive audiences into engaged contributors. We make this possible through our interactive presentation platform where the traditional presentation monologue becomes an inclusive dialogue. We believe in the power of together and that the most successful leaders listen to be heard.
With Mentimeter, users become the best presenter they can be. Meetings become more productive, participants learn more and have fun whilst doing it.
We have more than 300 million users and customers worldwide, on our way of making the world a better place, one presentation at a time.
As an Account Manager, you will lead the expansion of our existing Enterprise customers by focusing on revenue growth through renewals and up-sales while serving as a trusted adviser to our customers.
We expect you to have an entrepreneurial tempo with the main focus on commercial initiatives to drive revenue growth among our Enterprise customers. We are looking for someone who can create long-term and strategic relationships with out customers.
We use the theory of Predictable Revenue, and reference Dropbox and Slack when we see the future of Mentimeter. Mentimeter is a service that is loved globally and our growth has been almost 100% organic. Sales are currently growing over 10% per month and you will be the driving force to accelerate that growth even further.

Full commercial ownership of our current enterprise customers
Drive revenue growth by building a strong pipeline and expanding our customers. Your success is measured on Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
Manage a continuous pipeline for new expansion and up-sell opportunities
Build long-term, strategic relationships with customers all over North America
Ownership of renewals of ongoing agreements in order to prevent churn
Ability to assess business opportunities and use data in order to support decision-making towards customers
Develop a strategy for best-in-class scalable customer expansion and customer success
Collaborate together with Customer Success Managers on strategic enterprise customers in addition to working with other sales roles on a day to day basis
Work closely with the marketing and product team by serving as the voice of your customers as well as listening to the market needs

We strongly believe in the power of togetherness, and we put a lot of effort into collaboration, teamwork and helping each other whenever needed. We believe that every part of Mentimeter, from Sales Development Representatives and Account Executives to Frontend Developers and Marketing Managers contributes equally to our continued success.

At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues.

We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter.

Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun.

This is an early-in-career opportunity intended for candidates with limited professional experience.
The CSAM is an **early-in-career Customer Success Account Manager **who delivers standardized customer success outcomes spanning executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration activities. These CSAMs act within a pod model.
Working under the direction of senior CSAMs and a Manager, the CSAM operates within a defined pod covering a shared portfolio of accounts. The role contributes to portfolio-level intelligence, execution orchestration, and reactive signal aggregation - reducing context-switching for senior CSAMs and accelerating customer outcomes.
This is a talent-engine role: CSAMs are AI-first, customer-facing from month three, and grow through structured cohorts and community.

## Executive partnership and execution ##
* Execute standardized executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration tasks under direct guidance from senior CSAMs or CSU leaders.
* Support agent and Copilot adoption motions across assigned pod accounts.
* Complete assigned activities accurately and on time; escalate exceptions rather than independently diagnose them.
## Portfolio-level intelligence and preparation ##
* Maintain deep, current account context across the pod-s defined portfolio.
* Synthesize account signals into -what-s changed / what matters now-
* Detect risks, upcoming deliveries, upcoming milestones, and open threads.
* Detect portfolio patterns such as recurring blockers across multiple accounts.
## Execution orchestration (not delivery) ##
* Track delivery and milestone progress with partners and CSAs on behalf of senior CSAMs.
* Map dependencies across workloads and milestones.
* Proactively flag drift before the customer raises it.
* Coordinate remediation follow-ups across internal teams.
## Reactive signal aggregation ##
* Monitor reactive support signals - case volume, aging, repeat drivers - across the pod portfolio.
* Aggregate reactive trends into portfolio-level views and surface early warnings of escalation risk.
* Track follow-through on Support, IM, and Service Manager commitments; chase stalled internal owners.
* Distill reactive noise into CSAM-ready insights, not raw data.
## Operating model ##
* Operate within a pod model covering a shared portfolio of accounts.
* Work under direct oversight of the Manager and senior CSAMs assigned to the pod.
* Limit interactions to task execution and information capture; executive partnership and account governance is led by the senior CSAM.

## Required ##
* Bachelor-s degree (any discipline) or equivalent early-career experience.
* 0-2 years of professional experience in program management, customer-facing operations, technology delivery, or analytics.
* Demonstrated comfort with AI tools and AI-first ways of working.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English plus the language(s) required for the assigned hub.
* Legally authorised to work in the location where this role is based - Zurich, Switzerland (Legally authorised = you hold citizenship or have been granted a valid visa or work permit.) Relocation expenses are not provided as part of this role.
* Fluency in English must be mandatory
* Fluency in French AND/OR German is mandatory

* Coursework or experience in program management, business operations
* Exposure to enterprise software, cloud platforms, or B2B customer success.
* Experience working in pod, squad, or matrixed team structures.
